description: A small, hardy animal that ranges wide across forests and shrubland. It is happy to break into your garbage container, or your kitchen, to eat almost anything.

label: rat
description: A widely-hated rodent known for soiling kitchens and spreading disease, rats have a way of following humans everywhere they go. It eats almost anything and lives almost anywhere.

label: agave fruit
description: Raw agave fruit.

label: berries
description: Assorted berries. Nice to eat, even when raw.

label: corn
description: Raw corn.

label: raw fungus
description: Raw fungus.

label: hops
description: Raw hops. A flavoring and preserving agent that is necessary for making beer.

label: unrefined magicyte
description:
A stone that seems to wrap itself in a dull, glassy surface, as if a mysterious power has cloaked itself in the center of the stone. Seemingly composed of the same stone it was cut from, this fairly unremarkable stone shimmers slightly, even in the dark, and it emits an energy signature that mages can detect when touching the stone.
	
Raw Magicyte can be refined to make a variety of enchanting gems at the gemcutting table.

label: potatoes
description: Raw potatoes.

label: rice
description: Raw rice.

label: toxipotatoes
description: Raw toxipotatoes. Once harvested, toxipotatoes are very dietarily similar to potatoes. However, when eaten raw, they have a higher chance of causing food poisoning.

label: reinforced barrel
description: A large barrel for projectile-based weapons like mortars. In order to hold the high launch pressures, it is specially reinforced and cannot be manufactured at a small scale.

label: cube
description: A hand-sized cube. While now dormant, it was once unnaturally captivating.

label: remote repairer
description:
A mechlink upgrade which allows the mechanitor to repair mechs from a distance. The user links with the mechanoid and uses their own brain to psychically guide its self-repair mechanites.

This implant can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its range.

label: remote shielder
description:
An implant which allows the mechanitor to place a personal defense shield on a mech. The mechanitor must continuously focus on the mech in order to maintain the shield.

Placing a shield at a distance requires a substantial amount of focused energy. It can be used to save a mech at a critical moment.

This implant can be self-installed in the same way as the mechlink.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its range and shield energy.

label: repair probe
description:
An implant which increases the speed at which a mechanitor can repair a mechanoid. This does not affect the overall energy needed to repair a mechanoid.

The implant allows the mechanitor to plug directly into a mechanoid while they are repairing it. This allows them to more quickly understand the mech's injuries, and better-direct the mech's self-repair mechanites to assist with the repair.

This implant can be self-installed in the same way as the mechlink.

This implant can be installed up to 6 times to increase its effect.

label: reprocessor stomach
description: An advanced chemical processing system breaks down nutrients the body could normally never use, leading to increased efficiency.

label: respiration rib implant
description: An artificial rib, that works with the diaphragm to assist with regulating breathing pattern for increased efficiency and coping with stress.

label: revenant spine
description:
An articulated spine-like object from a dead revenant. It is a chaotic mesh of sharpened metal spokes, twisted into a warped cage. The material appears to be rough-cast black iron smeared in a dark, slippery fluid. Anyone who peers too closely inside its jagged form is left with a skull-splitting headache.

You can destroy the spine to permanently kill the revenant.

Alternatively, you can secure it on a holding platform and wait for the revenant to re-emerge, so you can study the captured entity.

label: revenant vertebrae
description: A prosthetic spine that allows the user to temporarily become invisible. The prosthetic is crafted from a modified revenant spine and uses archotech shards to restrain the dormant revenant. The user can manipulate the visual centers of those nearby, effectively turning themself invisible for a short time.

label: rhinoceros
description: Despite being herbivorous, this large mammal is very easy to enrage. Once angered, its massive strength and sharp horn make it a brutal opponent. It has more muscle in one leg than most humans do in their whole body.

label: Armor of the Valiant
description:
A breastplate etched in holy symbols that is designed to protect vital areas without restricting movement. Said to have been worn by holy warriors of a bygone age who maintained peace with justice and compassion in equal measure. It is unknown what became of this order, though it is hard to believe it had anything to do with their skill in armor craft.

Armor of the Valiant is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Energy Costs: -10%
Class XP Gain: +10%

label: royal bed
description: A luxurious gold-inlaid bed fit for the highborn. Very comfy and beautiful, it is a work of art in itself. Fits two.

label: royal bed (guest)
description: A luxurious gold-inlaid bed fit for the highborn. Very comfy and beautiful, it is a work of art in itself. Fits two. ...and this is for a guest. You should have already known that, genius.

label: Helm of the Valiant
description:
A barbute shaped helm designed to maximize protection without restricting vision or voice. These helmets are a complementary piece to the Armor of the Valiant set and further enhance a wearers arcane capabilities while also providing noteworthy physical protection.

Helm of the Valiant is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Energy Costs: -5%
Class XP Gain: +10%

label: rustic rug (broad)
description: A homey rug with a rustic-style pattern, for decorating a floor.

label: rustic rug (medium)
description: A homey rug with a rustic-style pattern, for decorating a floor.

label: sacrificial flag
description: A flag representing enemies, ready to be burned as part of a ritual.

label: blood torch
description: A specially-treated wooden torch that produces a red light over a large area. Sanguophages gather around torches like these during their ceremonial meetings. The sanguine glow is particularly pleasing to individuals with the bloodfeeder gene. It can be automatically refueled with wood, and produces a small amount of heat.

label: schematic
description: A book which describes technology and methods for using it. Reading schematics can help unlock new technologies.

label: school desk
description: A desk where adults can teach lessons to children.

label: grand sculpture
description: A huge sculpture sized to dominate a room.

label: large sculpture
description: A person-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form.

label: small sculpture
description: A torso-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form.

label: terror sculpture
description: A person-sized piece of material sculpted into a threatening form. Slaves who spend time around it will feel terror, which makes them stay suppressed for longer and thus reduces slave rebellions.

label: sea lion
description: A large and intelligent marine animal. Male sea lions have thick fur around their necks, which evoke a lion's mane.

label: sea turtle
description: A large marine turtle. Their streamlined shell and powerful flippers make them excellent swimmers.

label: seal
description: A marine mammal with a streamlined body that is adept at hunting fish. While slow on land, seals are relatively quick in water.

label: Seed of Regrowth
description: A seed required by a druid to begin the limb regrowth process. A druid must be trained in the art of regrowth to use this magical item successfully.

label: sentience catalyst
description: A single-use dose of mechanites used to enhance neural pathways in animals, permanently increasing their trainability and reducing their wildness.\n\nThe effect does not stack.

label: serum lab
description: A workbench that uses scavenged archotechnology to create single-use injectable serums. Serums produce diverse and exotic effects through the use of exotic archotech mechanites.

label: shard
description: A scavenged fragment of dark archotechnology. Originally created by a hyperintelligent archotech mind, this shard is packed with technology beyond human comprehension. It is capable of manipulating psychic flows, inducing archotech influences and more esoteric outcomes. While it is useless by itself, it can be built into devices that harness its power to produce exotic effects.

label: shard animal pulser
description: A one-use broad-wave psychic effector created from a dark archotech shard. The psychic pulse fills lower minds with terrifying imagery, driving all animals in the region into a manhunting rage. Animals currently under your control will not be affected.

label: shard beacon
description: A shard of dark archotechnology mounted on a bioferrite pedestal. The shard, focused by the bioferrite, shapes nearby dark psychic flows. When placed near a psychic ritual spot, it improves the ritual quality.\n\nA ritual can benefit from up to four shard beacons.

label: shard inhibitor
description: A shard of dark archotechnology that resonates with psychic energy, increasing the containment strength of any holding platform or spot within its radius.\n\nThe effect does not stack.

label: sheep
description: Sheep husbandry is practiced throughout the majority of the inhabited worlds, however only recently it has been introduced to the rimworlds. Domestic sheep are relatively small herbivores, usually with yellowish wool and medium sized horns.

label: shelf
description: A triple-stack shelf that holds three times as much as empty ground. Items stored inside will never deteriorate and don't affect the beauty of their surroundings.\n\nSince shelf space is limited, shelves cannot hold chunks, buildings, plants and large corpses.

label: small shelf
description: A small triple-stack shelf that holds three times as much as empty ground. Items stored inside will never deteriorate and don't affect the beauty of their surroundings.\n\nSince shelf space is limited, shelves cannot hold chunks, buildings, plants and large corpses.

label: antigrain warhead
description: An ultra-tech warhead powered by a grain of antimatter. Usually used by spacecraft or glitterworld war machines, it creates a huge explosion and starts fires around the target. Can be fired from mortars or installed as a trap. Explodes when damaged.

label: deadlife shell
description: An artillery shell packed with a dust-like substance that, after exploding into a cloud, will settle on nearby human and animal corpses and raise them as shamblers. The shamblers will only attack your enemies.\n\nThis can be fired from mortars or installed as a trap. Explodes when damaged.

label: EMP shell
description: A shell filled with batteries and antennas, for generating an electromagnetic pulse when detonated. Electromagnetic pulses temporarily disable electrical devices and mechanoids. Can be fired from mortars or installed as a trap. Explodes when damaged.

label: firefoam shell
description: A pressurized shell filled with fire-retardant foam. Can be fired from mortars or installed as a trap. Explodes when damaged.

label: high-explosive shell
description: A shell filled with high explosives. Can be fired from mortars or installed as a trap. Explodes when damaged.

label: incendiary shell
description: A shell filled with flammable gel and a small explosive charge. Starts fires when detonated. Can be fired from mortars or installed as a trap. Explodes when damaged.

label: smoke shell
description: A shell that generates a cloud of smoke when detonated, obscuring incoming shots and preventing turrets from locking on. Can be fired from mortars or installed as a trap. Explodes when damaged.

label: tox shell
description: An artillery shell containing reagents that, when combined, generate deadly tox gas. When fired, it will stick into the ground and release tox gas for some time before expiring.\n\nTox gas burns the lungs and eyes, causing a temporary shortness of breath and reduction in sight. Continued exposure to tox gas results in toxic buildup that can be lethal.

label: ship landing beacon
description: Marks the corner of a landing area. Four of these placed at the corners of a clear area (minimum 9x9) create a landing pad. Spacecraft usually land on pads if possible.

label: Shooting Range Target
description: A training platform for a pawn to use for Shooting.

label: shuttle engine
description: An engine capable of powering a small shuttle. Shuttle engines can only be manufactured in large specialized factories, making them rare on the rim.

label: signal chip
description: A mechanoid-band synchronization micro-organ. It is necessary to produce certain advanced types of mechanoids and equipment.\n\nA mechanitor can study this chip to help unlock higher tiers of mechtech research.

label: signal jammer
description: A signal emitter that disguises the electromagnetic signature of your gravship, allowing it to approach heavily-defended landing sites.

label: silent jaw
description: An advanced artificial jaw. Silenced mini-servos give great jaw strength, but this version comes without a voice modulator. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage. Useful for abrasive patients.

label: silver
description: This metal is mostly used as a commodity currency. It can also be used for making decorations.

label: prosthetic arm
description: An arm prosthesis. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real arm.

label: prosthetic finger
description: Archaic and crude replacement for lost fingers. Not terribly efficient and certainly not comfortable, but gets the job done.

label: prosthetic foot
description: A foot prosthesis. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real foot.

label: prosthetic hand
description: A hand prosthesis. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real hand.

label: surrogate heart
description: A heart prosthesis. It contains an electric motor that pumps blood smoothly around the body. Users often report feeling tired, but it's better than the alternative.

label: prosthetic leg
description: A leg prosthesis. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real leg.

label: prosthetic toe
description: Archaic and crude replacement for lost toes. Inefficient and uncomfortable, they generate a lot of noise while walking, but they get the job done.

label: simple research bench
description: A simple bench with writing implements and simple measurement devices. Researchers work here to discover new things.

label: blank rib replacement
description: A hollow artificial rib, with a tiny dispenser system. Ready to be filled to complete a rib replacement implant of choice.

label: replacement spine
description: A spine prosthesis. Highly advanced for its time, can be considered as an early bionic prototype with the first sophisticated application of neural interface in a prosthesis. Still, it is inferior to a real spine.

label: Fighter Skill: Burning Fury
description: Teaches a fighter class how to activate the Burning Fury aura. Non-violent pawns cannot learn this skill.

label: Fighter Skill: Fighters Focus
description: Teaches a fighter class how to dedicate an allotment of stamina to withstand greater mental and physical stress.

label: Fighter Skill: Gear Repair
description: Teaches a fighter class how to dedicate an allotment of stamina to maintaining and repairing worn equipment.

label: Fighter Skill: Heavy Blow
description: Teaches a fighter class how to dedicate an allotment of stamina to increase the power of each attack.

label: Apothecary Recipe: Bliss
description: Teaches an apothecary how to create Bliss - a drug that induces a state of bliss, able to completely mask nearly all emotions and pain. This drug also causes skill loss and dramatically slows skill gain.

label: Apothecary Recipe: Clarity
description: Teaches an apothecary how to create Clarity - a drug that reduces resistance to the arcane, giving mages a large boost to mana regeneration and increasing psychic sensitivity. May also cause deterioration in mental stability.

label: Fighter Skill: Inner Healing
description: Teaches a fighter class how to dedicate an allotment of stamina and physical energy to increase healing rate and improve disease immunity.

label: Fighter Skill: Legion
description: Teaches a fighter how to replicate the combat abilities of another fighter class.

label: Fighter Skill: Pommel Strike
description: Teaches a fighter class how to perform a non-lethal blow to stun or knock-out a target.

label: Fighter Skill: Sprint
description: Teaches a fighter class how to dedicate an allotment of stamina to sustain an increased movement rate.

label: Fighter Skill: Strong Back
description: Teaches a fighter class how to dedicate an allotment of stamina to increase carrying and inventory capacities.

label: Fighter Skill: Taunt
description: Teaches a fighter class how to taunt nearby enemies.

label: Fighter Skill: Tempest Strike
description: Teaches a fighter class a technique to strike in rapid succession using their weapon.

label: Fighter Skill: Thick Skin
description: Teaches a fighter class how to dedicate an allotment of stamina to increase armor values and temperature threshold.

label: Fighter Skill: Throwing Knife
description: Teaches a fighter class the Throwing Knife skill. Non-violent pawns cannot learn this skill.

label: skull
description: A human skull.

label: skullspike
description: A spike mounted upright for the purpose of piercing and displaying a human skull. To some, displayed skulls are a symbol of power. To others, they represent barbaric evil. Skullspikes are an especially brutal and effective way to terrorize slaves.

label: slab bed
description: A slab of hard material made to sleep on. Slab beds are uncomfortable, but some see their use as a demonstration of moral good.

label: slab bed (guest)
description: A slab of hard material made to sleep on. Slab beds are uncomfortable, but some see their use as a demonstration of moral good. ...and this is for a guest. You should have already known that, genius.

label: slab double bed
description: A slab of hard material made to sleep on. Slab beds are uncomfortable, but some see their use as a demonstration of moral good. This one is wide enough to fit two people.

label: slab double bed (guest)
description: A slab of hard material made to sleep on. Slab beds are uncomfortable, but some see their use as a demonstration of moral good. This one is wide enough to fit two people. ...and this is for a guest. You should have already known that, genius.

label: sleep accelerator
description: A bedside device that accelerates the sleeper's circadian rhythm. This speeds up sleep, but consumes a lot of electricity and also causes increased hunger. It must be placed directly adjacent to and facing the head of the bed. Placing more than one sleep accelerator near the same bed has no effect.

label: sleep suppressor
description: A scavenged archotech shard mounted in an electrical control frame. The device creates a psychic pulsation in the local area which alters the brain chemistry of those nearby, halting the buildup of fatigue toxins and removing the need for sleep. However, it also irritates anyone nearby.

label: small thruster
description: A chemfuel thruster that increases the range of a gravship. Thrusters require an unobstructed area free of large buildings and gravship substructure.\n\nA gravship can support up to four small thrusters.

label: smokeleaf joint
description: Smokeleaf leaves prepared in small rolls for smoking. The drug improves mood, but also increases appetite, reduces focus and slows movement. Smokeleaf use can produce a dependency.\n\nJoints can be produced at a crafting spot without equipment, and are a fixture in many traditional low-industriousness cultures.

label: smokeleaf leaves
description: Raw cut leaves of a smokeleaf plant. Can be rolled into smokeable joints at a crafting spot.

label: snowhare
description: This hardy animal survives the brutal winters of its homelands by burrowing through snow to find edible plants.

label: sparrow
description: Small birds that often travel in flocks. They can thrive in a variety of environments.

label: Ice Spell: Alter Storm
description: Teaches an Ice mage how to alter the conditions of a storm to produce various effects.

label: Mage Spell: Arcane Bolt
description: Teaches a magic user how to forcefully project arcane energy.

label: Bard Spell: Battle Hymn
description: Teaches a bard how to perform Battle Hymn.

label: Enchanter Spell: Blank Mind
description: Teaches an enchanter how to wipe memories and break a pawn out of a mental state or cause a long duration stun on enemies.

label: Mage Spell: Blink
description: Teaches a magic user how arcane forces are interconnected, allowing the mage to rapidly move short distances.

label: Ice Spell: Blizzard
description: Teaches an ice mage how to call forth a blizzard to bury your foes in a hail of ice and snow.

label: Blood Mage Spell: Blood Moon
description: Teaches a blood mage how to summon a vicious pack of blood demons.

label: Mage Spell: Blur
description: Teaches a magic user how to distort the light around their body.

label: Golemancer Spell: Awareness Brand
description: Teaches a golemancer the sigil to create an awareness brand.

label: Golemancer Spell: Emotion Brand
description: Teaches a golemancer the sigil to create an emotion brand.

label: Golemancer Spell: Fitness Brand
description: Teaches a golemancer the sigil to create a fitness brand.

label: Golemancer Spell: Protection Brand
description: Teaches a golemancer the sigil to create a protection brand.

label: Golemancer Spell: Siphon Brand
description: Teaches a golemancer the sigil to create a siphoning brand.

label: Golemancer Spell: Vitality Brand
description: Teaches a golemancer the sigil to create a vitality brand.

label: Druid Spell: Briar Patch
description: Teaches a Druid how to rapidly grow a hazard made of thorny vines.

label: Fire Spell: Cauterize Wound
description: Teaches a fire mage how to use elemental fire to instantly clean and close wounds - may leave burn scars.

label: Lightning Spell: Charge Battery
description:
Teaches a lightning mage how to charge a battery by infusing it with magical energy.
Produces 400Wd adjusted by ability power.

label: Necromancer Spell: Mass Consume Corpse
description: Teaches a necromancer how to expand consume corpse to target multiple corpses within an area.

label: Mage Spell: Magic Cooler
description: Teaches an arcane user how to create a temporary window into the plane of ice, creating a temporary cooling source.

label: Mage Spell: Dirt Devil
description: Teaches a magic user how to create a whirlwind that seeks out and cleans filth inside the home area.

label: Bard Spell: Discord
description: Teaches a bard how to distort the mental harmony of a target pawn.

label: Fire Spell: Dry Ground
description: Teaches a fire mage how to infuse the earth with heat, evaporating most of the water from a small patch of earth.

label: Mage Spell: EMP
description: Teaches a magic user how to generate an EMP burst at a target location.

label: Mage Spell: Extinguish
description: Teaches a magic user how to remove the element of fire at a target location, dispersing fires.

label: Lightning Spell: Eye of the Storm
description: Teaches a lightning mage how to contain the raw fury of a lightning storm into a small sphere and project it along a set path.

label: Empath Ability: Fade Emotions
description: This scroll describes how an empath can use their abilities to focus the emotions of a negative memory so that the target pawn can let go of the emotions and move on.

label: Druid Spell: Fertile Lands
description: Teaches a druid how to bless an area of land with fertile growth.

label: Fire Spell: Firestorm
description: Teaches a fire mage how to wield the full fury of the fire element to scorch the earth with a firestorm.

label: Arcane Spell: Gateway
description: Teaches an arcane mage how to fold reality in order to open a temporary window between colonies.

label: Shaman Spell: Guardian Spirit
description: Teaches a shaman how to call forth their guardian spirit.

label: Mage Spell: Heal
description: Teaches a magic user how to delicately manipulate arcane forces to heal injuries.

label: Fire Spell: Heat Shield
description: Teaches a fire mage how to create a protective barrier against heat and fire.

label: Mage Spell: Magic Heater
description: Teaches a magic user how to create a temporary window into the plane of fire, creating a temporary heat source.

label: Paladin Spell: Holy Wrath
description: Teaches a paladin how to call forth the wrath of the gods.

label: Mage Spell: Ignite
description: Teaches a magic user how to concentrate heat at a target location.

label: Mage Spell: Invisibility
description: Teaches a magic user how to manipulate light and become invisible.

label: Necromancer Spell: Lich Form
description: Teaches a necromancer how to transform into a lich.

label: Mage Spell: Lightning Trap
description: Teaches a magic user how to create a trap that discharges bolts of lightning.

label: Golemancer Spell: Living Wall
description: Teaches a golemancer how to give a wall a will of its own.

label: Mage Spell: Mage Light
description: Teaches a magic user how to create a small orb of light.

label: Mage Spell: Magic Wardrobe
description: Teaches a magic user how to create a dimensional pocket to store a reserve set of equipment.

label: Mage Spell: Mana Shield
description: Teaches a magic user how to form a protective mana barrier to prevent physical harm.

label: Technomancer Spell: Mechanite Reprogramming
description: Teaches a technomancer how to reprogramming fibrous or sensory mechanites in a way that enhances the attributes of the host.

label: Geomancer Spell: Meteor
description: Teaches a geomancer how to summon a massive meteor to bury an area in rock and debris.

label: Technomancer Spell: Orbital Strike
description: Teaches a technomancer how to access ancient satellites and orbital systems and use them to launch an orbital strike.

label: Technomancer Spell: Overdrive
description: Teaches a technomancer user how to over-clock or bypass security features of mechanical, electrical, and robotic devices causing it to perform at a drastically increased rate for a short period.

label: Mage Spell: Power Node
description: Teaches a magic user how to create a contained power node that converts arcane energy into electrical power. Place next to existing power grid. Supplies 600 power.

label: Warlock Spell: Psychic Shock
description: Teaches a Warlock how to use his psychic powers to emit powerful psychic shock that overwhelms and reverberates from nearby pawn.

label: Mage Spell: Rain
description: Teaches a magic user how to harness energy in the atmosphere to induce a brief rain.

label: Chronomancer Spell: Recall
description: Teaches a chronomancer how to recall their physical being to a past condition.

label: Druid Spell: Regrow Limb
description: Teaches a druid how to regrow limbs by combining nature, arcane powers, and medical science.

label: Priest Spell: Resurrection
description: Teaches a priest how to restore the spark of life to the recently deceased.

label: Technomancer Spell: Sabotage
description: Teaches a technomancer user how to create a feedback loop in almost any mechanic system, causing it to catastrophically malfunction.

label: Succubus Spell: Scorn
description: Teaches a succubus how to unleash the full malice harbored by their demon heart.

label: Enchanter Spell: Shapeshift
description: Teaches an enchanter how to perform shapeshifting on themselves without losing their identity.

label: Holy Caster Spell: Shield Other
description: Teaches a holy caster (paladin, priest, etc) how to shield another from damage.

label: Mage Spell: Siphon Mana
description: Teaches a magic user how to siphon mana from another mage.  If used on a being that does not possess mana, their physical traits will be drained instead (no mana will be gained).  Effect is potentially lethal in extreme cases.

label: Mage Spell: Smoke Cloud
description: Teaches a magic user how to ignite particles in the air to create a smokescreen, temporarily concealing a target area.

label: Mage Spell: Snap Freeze
description: Teaches a magic user how to remove all heat at a target location.

label: Mage Spell: Spell Mending
description: Teaches a magic user how to reconstruct and repair worn equipment on a pawn.

label: Brightmage Spell: Spirit Of Light
description: Teaches a Brightmage how to summon a Spirit of Light.

label: Mage Spell: Summon Minion
description: Teaches a magic user how to summon an otherworldly minion to assist in basic tasks.

label: Summoner Spell: Summon Poppi
description: Teaches a summoner how to summon a band of cute and cuddly poppi.

label: Mage Spell: Sun Light
description: Teaches a magic user how to create a dimensional pocket that emits a steady stream of sunlight strong enough to grow plants. Sun Light must be sustained by the mage that creates it and will reduce maximum mana and mana regeneration rate.

label: Technomancer Spell: Kinetic Shield
description: Teaches a technomancer user how to create a uni-directional force field around a target, capable of repelling inbound projectiles or increasing the velocity of outbound projectiles.

label: Mage Spell: Teleport
description: Teaches a magic user how to manipulate energy using arcane dimensions, allowing the mage to create a portal for rapid transport.

label: Mage Spell: Transfer Mana
description: Teaches a magic user how to transfer mana to another mage.  If raw mana is infused into a non-mage recepient, their physical traits will be temporarily augmented.

label: Ice Spell: Moisturize Ground
description: Teaches an ice mage how to infuse the earth with moisture and nutrients, transforming sand into usable soil.

label: spelopede
description: A medium-sized bioengineered insectoid the size of a sheep. The spelopede is the middle caste of a hive, taking care of most work tasks as well as fighting with its digging claws. It's dangerous in combat, but slow on open ground.

label: spikecore floor-star (broad)
description: A radial arrangement of metal pieces in a spikecore style, for decorating a floor.

label: spikecore floor-star (medium)
description: A radial arrangement of metal pieces in a spikecore style, for decorating a floor.

label: squirrel
description: One of the many hardy rodent species that follows humankind everywhere it spreads. Squirrels are distinguished by their bushy tails, which they use as umbrellas in bad weather.

label: standing lamp
description: An electrical standing lamp that lights an area. People need light to move and work at full speed.

label: statue
description: A sculpture depicting a specific person. Artists will often make statues depicting friends or loved ones.

label: steel
description: An iron-carbon metal alloy used for building a huge variety of structures, weapons, and machines.

label: steel arm
description: A very poor arm replacement. Looks bad, feels bad, is bad.

label: stomach
description: Digests food and turns it into energy and nutrients.

label: stone crab
description: A robust crustacean with powerful claws. Stone crabs are a delicacy in some regions.

label: stoneskin gland
description: This bionic gland releases chemical and nanomachines that transform the user's skin into a built-in suit of armor. The whole epidermis thickens and hardens to resist burns, while jointed exterior keratin plates form everywhere they can - including the head and face. While it's very difficult to physically hurt someone using this implant, the plates and hard skin significantly reduces the user's physical attractiveness.

label: stool
description: A simple platform on which to sit. Not very comfortable, but much better than nothing. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.

label: styling station
description: A table with a mirror and styling tools. People can use this to change their look.

label: basic subcore
description: The simplest possible mechanoid brain, this is a tiny psychodynamic substrate unit housing a dull subpersona. Since this is only a basic-tier subcore, it can only drive the simplest of mechanoids.\n\nLike all mechanoid subcores, it contains a subpersona with a psychic presence, albeit a very faint one.

label: subcore encoder
description: A work station where a mechanitor can produce basic-tier subcores. Subcores are the brains of mechanoids, and one is required to produce any mechanoid. Basic subcores can only be used in simple basic-tier mechs.\n\nHigher tier subcores can be created by building a subcore softscanner or a subcore ripscanner.

label: high subcore
description:
A high-tier mechanoid brain, this is a psychodynamic substrate unit which supports a sophisticated subpersona. This particular subcore is of the strongest tier, and can power complex ultra-heavy mechanoids.

The subpersona inside this core approaches a live human in its complexity, though it is of a very different nature. Like any such mind, it has a noticeable psychic presence.

This subcore could only have been produced by rich pattern transfer from another sophisticated mind. The only way to do this without huge facilities is to ripscan a living person's brain, killing them in the process.

label: standard subcore
description: A standard-tier mechanoid brain, this is a psychodynamic substrate unit supporting a thinking subpersona. This particular subcore is strong enough to drive standard-tier mechanoids.\n\nMechanoids are more than robots, and this is more than a silicon computer. Its thinking, psychically-present subpersona makes it more adaptable than silicon systems. However, this also means it can only be produced by analog pattern transfer from another thinking mind.

label: sun lamp
description: An industrial lamp which lights an area brightly enough to grow crops, but consumes a huge amount of power. Automatically turns itself off at night.

label: surrogate kidney
description: A kidney prosthesis. It contains artificial filters and removes waste products from the blood. Users often report feeling slightly unwell, but it's better than the alternative.

label: surrogate liver
description: A liver prosthesis. It contains chemical synthesizers to imitate the liver's role in metabolism. Users often report feeling slightly unwell, but it's better than the alternative.

label: surrogate lung
description: A lung prosthesis. It contains an electric motor that expands and contracts the prosthesis for gas exchanges, simulating breathing. Users often report feeling tired, but it's better than the alternative.

label: surrogate stomach
description: A stomach prosthesis. It contains chemical synthesizers that can digest most foodstuff, the strength of them is limited as to not dissolve the prosthesis itself. It is rather inefficient at the job, but it is better than the alternative.

label: swan
description: Large graceful waterfowl known for their beauty, and their surprising ferocity.

label: synthetic kidney
description: An advanced artificial kidney. A set of sensors and synthetic filters that efficiently removes waste products from the blood. It is better than a biological kidney in almost every way.

label: synthetic liver
description: An advanced artificial liver. A set of sensors and chemical synthesizers monitors and replicate the liver's role in metabolism, instantly adapting to changes in the body. It is better than a biological liver in almost every way.

label: synthetic lung
description: An advanced artificial lung. It has synthetic muscle fibers for a realistic breathing, plus a high-flow pump for rapid deep breathes during intensive activities. It is better than a biological lung in almost every way.

label: synthetic tissue
description: A patch of organo-synthetic tissue which can replace damaged areas.

label: synthread
description: Spacer-tech synthetic fabric designed for making ordinary clothes. It is soft, light, strong, and insulates well.

label: arcalleum
description:
A metal alloy consisting of steel, jade, silver and magicyte. Its unique composition gives it mystical properties that increased elasticity and creates reverberations of any magical energy transferred through it. The elasticity of the alloy makes it an excellent choice for blunt protection, but is sub-standard for use in bladed weapons. Arcalleum is difficult to create and requires a forge capable of liquefying and combining all ingredients of the alloy.
	
	While arcalluem is sought after for its enhanced defensive properties, it is also prized by fighters and mages alike for its power to nullify the cooldown of any ability. Each kg of arcalleum worn increases the chance an ability cooldown is nullified after use by 1% (50% max).

label: Bracers of Defense
description:
Bracers crafted into hardened material that allow the wearer to block physical attacks. 40% block chance.

Enchantments:
Arcane Resistance 10%

label: Bracers of Deflection
description:
Bracers crafted into reactive material that allow the wearer to block attacks and deflect projectiles. 30% block chance, all blocked attacks are deflected against enemies within 8 cells.

Enchantments:
Arcane Resistance 10%

label: Bracers of the Pacifist
description:
These bracers appear to be little more than thin cloth wrapped in leather, but their unremarkable appearance is belied by remarkable power. This item can only be worn by a pawn that has rejected violence.

Enchantments:
Max Energy +40%
Energy Regen +40%
Arcane Resistance +50%
Arcane Recovery - decreases time to recover from arcane weakness

label: Shard of Spirit Extraction
description:
This mysterious shard is capable of extracting the martial or arcane talents of a pawn and converting it to essence. The shard is destroyed after use.
	
*Note: this item completely removes a pawn's class and any associated abilities and skills. The pawn may learn another class following a spirit extraction.

label: Necrotic Orb
description:
An artifact that enhances the necrotic energy required to sustain the undead. The Necrotic Orb functions much like a battery; when equipped by a pawn that is sustaining undead, it absorbs energy from a necromancer as if it were an undead itself, however, it also reduces the total upkeep cost to sustain undead by 25%. When no energy is available from a necromancer, it will disperse energy to sustain undead.
	
Only one orb may be equipped by a pawn. Orbs only take affect when equipped by a pawn sustaining undead.

label: Orb Of Conviction
description:
Also known as the Traitors Trinket, Orb of Insanity, and Mind Thief - the Orb of Conviction is a powerful and dangerous artifact. When filled with the conviction and magic of a caster, it can be used to press that conviction upon another.
	
If successful, the target will immediately join the casters faction, but will be affected by psychic shock.

Only the most powerful mages can direct the power of this artifact; even then, it will exact a heavy price. The orb will implode once the spell has been cast and can only be used once.

label: Orb of the Eternal
description:
A single use infusion of magical energy prepared to heal wounds, restore limbs, and cure diseases. The healing energy will target and heal the single worst health condition affecting someone at any given time.

Orbs of the Eternal have been used by mages, rulers, and the elite to prolong life. These orbs are valuable and rare due mostly to the secrecy surrounding the process of crafting an orb.

label: Orb of Souls (empty)
description:
The Orb of Souls is a powerful and dangerous artifact. It requires no external power and can extract the soul of a pawn possessing traits.
	
If successful, the Orb of Souls will absorb all traits from the target; the target will lose the absorbed traits. The process is almost always lethal.

Once filled, the Orb of Souls can be used to transfers the absorbed traits into another human-like pawn.

label: Orb of Souls (filled)
description:
The Orb of Souls is a powerful and dangerous artifact. This orb has absorbed traits and can be used to infuse these traits into a human-like pawn.

Conflicting traits can never transfer into the target pawn. If the pawn possesses over 7 traits, then there is a 75% chance that a random, existing trait will be replaced with the trait being infused.

The orb will implode and be destroyed once the traits have been released.

label: Ring of Blood
description:
A ring inset with a dark stone; currents of deep red and black swirl beneath its surface. This type of ring was first created by an ancient vampire to increase blood reserves and can be used by a blood mage to store blood magic.

The Ring of Blood's power depends on the fame of its bearer and will grow with each human downed or killed.

label: Ring of the Eternal Blue
description:
A ring that seems to pulse with a soft blue light. This ring increases psychic sensitivity and reciprocates the psychic sensitivity of its bearer.

The Ring of Eternal Blue will increase a psionic's energy proportionally with their psychic sensitivity.

label: Ring of Keen Intellect
description:
A ring that expands the mind and heightens mental acuity but increases mental stress.

Enchantments:
XP Gain +25%

label: Ring of Malice
description:
This ring gives off a dark aura and is perpetually cold to touch. The Ring of Malice increases the idle and maximum hate levels of a death knight.

The Ring of Malice's power depends on the fame of its bearer and will grow with each wound taken or inflicted.

label: Staff of Blazing Power
description:
A staff that creates a mental link with the wielder to harness focused energy that can be used to launch a stream of blazing projectiles or create a hardened barrier around the wielder that can deflect projectiles. Mages gain tremendous boosts to magical spells while wielding this staff but to a mundane pawn it is nothing but a blunt weapon.

This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +20
Energy Regen: +10%
Damage Boost: +40%

label: combat manual
description: A manual describes various combat techniques.

label: Decimation
description:
A two handed mace so heavily enchanted that it tears apart the cohesion of any material it strikes. It is forged seemingly from a single piece of metal and wielded from a handle wrapped in simple leather. Finely etched runes cover the surface of the mace, making it appear almost delicate. When held, the quality of the design is apparent, with perfect balance and solid handling despite the authoritative finality of its weight. Each blow has a chance to inflict frailty on the target, causing it to take more damage from subsequent attacks.
		
This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +40
Arcane Resistance: +40%
Damage Boost: +30%
Frailty on hit (50%)

label: Staff of the Defender
description:
A staff crafted from an ancient design bearing a palpable aura of wisdom. This staff is able to tap into the spirit realm and allow the wielder to communicate with their ancestral spirits who can manifest their power in the form of a physical barrier. The energy to perform this action comes from the spirits themselves and does not draw energy from the user, though the spirits require time to rest between requests.

This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +30
Energy Regen: +20%
Arcane Resistance: +20%

Ability: Arcane Barrier

label: demon's fang
description:
A deadly short blade that can inflict nightshade toxin. The Demon's Fang is light-weight with quick attacks and will benefit from the type of material used in it's crafting. However, the raw damage of this weapon is lower than other high-tier weapons. Due to the nature of it's crafting, it does benefit from several hefty enchantments that will augment it's user's skills.
		
This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Energy Costs: -10%
Ability Cooldown: -15%
Damage Boost: +25%
Nightshade Toxin on hit (20%)

label: demonhide
description: The skin of a demon. This material is incredibly tough with a micro-porous material mesh able to rapidly diffuse heat and cushion impact blows better than most non-metals. The blood of a demon is resistant to magic and leather made from the hide of a demon absorbs some of this resistance. Any enchantments carved into demonhide are naturally augmented. There are only two downsides to this material - the first is that it can only be acquired from the carcass of a demon, which makes it both rare and costly; the second is that it makes a terrible insulator.

label: demonscale
description: Pried from the body of a demon, these scales offer a lightweight and versatile defense against all forms of attack. Demon scale excels as a natural barrier to magic and is an excellent inhibitor to heat and fire; a warrior with enough armor crafted from demon scale may even become immune to all but the most intense fire. Demon scale can be smelted, and weapons forged from this refined metal make excellent bladed weapons. Enchantments etched into demon scale equipment are naturally augmented.

label: dire wolf
description: Dire wolves roam the north in great packs and fear neither man nor megasloth. A savage predator armed with razor sharp teeth and a coat like steel thread, dire wolves are as fierce as any known creature. They are often tied to mythical lore and are said to possess a unique link to arcane powers.

label: Disciple Hood
description:
Emblazoned with symbols and sigils that carry profound significance within the disciple's chosen path, this hood becomes a canvas for sacred artistry. Each stitch tells a tale of trials faced, wisdom gained, and the ongoing journey towards a higher plane of understanding. The hood serves not only as a physical covering but as a metaphysical barrier, shielding the disciple from distractions and worldly influences.

The Disiple Hood is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +25%
Energy Regen: +5%
Energy Costs: -5%
Class XP Gain: +10%
Arcane Resistance: +15%

label: Disciple Robe
description:
The uniform of an ardent disciple - this outfit is comprised of assorted pockets, pouches, and straps designed to allow the disciple to be prepared for any situation. Wearers of the disciple robe value protection and adaptability.
	
Disciple robes are enchanted and provide additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +20%
Energy Regen: +5%
Energy Costs: -5%
Class XP Gain: +10%
Arcane Res: +30%

label: Dragon Slayer Plate
description:
This masterpiece of craftsmanship and resilience is a symphony of layered plates intricately layered over an armored mesh that offers unmatched protection. Gleaming rivets and jagged edges trace a pattern reminiscent of ethereal flames engulfing a fearless warrior. Forged in the crucible of peril, Dragon Slayer plate is a symbol of defiance against scaled tyrants that darken the sky and mechanical abominations that despoil the land. Infused with enchanted energies, the armor radiates magical might that acts as a guiding light - assuring that this warrior shall emerge victorious amidst fire and fang.

Dragon slayer Plate is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +30
Energy Regen: +20%
Ability Cooldown: -20%
Energy Costs: -20%
Arcane Res: +30%
Ability Damage: +30%

label: Dreamcatcher Buckskin
description:
A patchwork buckskin of threaded leather adorned with animal memento and permeated with mystical energies. Primarily worn by tribal mystic leaders, the dreamcatcher buckskin represents the dream-like connection between nature and spirits. 
	
Mystics derive additional power from the symbolism of this outfit:
Max Energy: +40
Class XP Gain: +30%
Arcane Res: +25%

label: Dreamcatcher Coronet
description:
A patchwork headdress of animal leather topped with a majestic crown of antlers. This hood marks the bearer as the spiritual leader of a tribe. The dreamcatcher raiment is said to grant gifted users with the ability to view nature through the eyes of their spirit animal.

Mystics derive additional power from the symbolism of this outfit:
Max Energy: +25
Class XP Gain: +20%
Arcane Res: +20%

label: Arcane Gem of Force
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this enchantment augments the force of an attack, increasing the damage output by 8%.

label: Major Arcane Gem of Force
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this enchantment augments the force of an attack, increasing the damage output by 12%.

label: Minor Arcane Gem of Force
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this enchantment augments the force of an attack, increasing the damage output by 4%.

label: Arcane Gem of Resistance
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this gem creates a barrier that repels active arcane energy, reducing damage taken from arcane sources by 20%.

description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this gem creates a barrier that repels active arcane energy, reducing damage taken from arcane sources by 30%.

description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this gem creates a barrier that repels active arcane energy, reducing damage taken from arcane sources by 10%.

label: Arcane Gem of Acceleration
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this gem decreases the cooldown timer of any ability by 5%.

Gazing into the stone gives the observer an eerie sense of vertigo, as if looking into a bottomless well. This gem can be used to imbue an item with magical potential, increasing the maximum energy of any mage or fighter wearing the item by 10%.

description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. This gem can be used to imbue an item with magical potential, increasing the maximum energy of any mage or fighter wearing the item by 15%.

label: Arcane Gem of Conservation
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this gem decreases the energy cost of any spell by 5%.

label: Major Arcane Gem of Conservation
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this gem decreases the energy cost of any spell by 7%.

label: Minor Arcane Gem of Conservation
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this gem decreases the energy cost of any spell by 3%.

label: Arcane Gem of Regeneration
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. This gem can be used to imbue an item, increasing the energy regeneration rate of any mage or fighter wearing the item by 10%.

label: Major Arcane Gem of Regeneration
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. This gem can be used to imbue an item, increasing the energy regeneration rate of any mage or fighter wearing the item by 15%.

label: Minor Arcane Gem of Regeneration
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. This gem can be used to imbue an item, increasing the energy regeneration rate of any mage or fighter wearing the item by 5%.

label: Arcane Gem of Wonder
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. This gem hums with intense power. This gem can be used to imbue an item with magical potential, granting moderate bonuses to all enchantment categories.

label: Major Arcane Gem of Wonder
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. This gem hums with intense power. This gem can be used to imbue an item with magical potential, granting major bonuses to all enchantment categories.

label: Minor Arcane Gem of Wonder
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. This gem hums with intense power. This gem can be used to imbue an item with magical potential, granting minor bonuses to all enchantment categories.

label: Arcane Gem of Learning
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this gem assists the wearer by storing a residual mimicry of the ability, allowing the wielder additional introspection and increasing XP gained by 10%.

label: Major Arcane Gem of Learning
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this gem assists the wearer by storing a residual mimicry of the ability, allowing the wielder additional introspection and increasing XP gained by 15%.

label: Minor Arcane Gem of Learning
description: A magical stone that can be used by a mage to enchant an item with magical energy. When imbued into an item, this gem assists the wearer by storing a residual mimicry of the ability, allowing the wielder additional introspection and increasing XP gained by 5%.

label: Elephant Bow
description:
A bow shaped from elephant tusks. The tusks are hallowed out to decrease rigidity and reduce weight and softened by soaking it in a magicyte compound that increases suppleness. The elephant bow offers significant improvements in range and accuracy for distant targets over the greatbow, though it is slightly more difficult to handle.
	
The elephant bow is engraved with minor enchantments and is a preferred weapon by many experienced rangers and hunters.

This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +5
Energy Regen: +5%
Damage Boost: +10%
Ability Cooldown: -10%

label: elephant spear
description:
The elephant spear is crafted using the tusks of an elephant, and is typically a status symbol reserved for head hunters or leaders of a tribe. The shaft is engraved with minor enchantments, further boosting the combat abilities of the user.
		
This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +10
Damage Boost: +10%
Arcane Resistance: +20%

label: elephant tusk
description: This elephant tusk has been fashioned into a long knife useful in close combat for both piercing and slashing attacks. The hilt is wrapped in leather to and has a small counter-balance to improve handling, and the light weight of the blade allow for quick attacks. However, the low weight and softer blade make it a poor choice against a heavily armored opponent.

label: Wand of Fire
description:
A wand able to slowly convert nearby arcane energy into elemental fire. Wands are used as focusing tools to harness innate power more than as a weapon itself.
	
This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +5
Energy Regen: +5%
Damage Boost: +15%

label: flesh golem
description: A golem crafted from the flesh, bones and organs of other beings and given basic autonomy through a combination of bioengineering and magic.

label: Glory Maul
description:
A one handed mace designed for effectiveness against a variety of foes. The head of the Glory Maul has a blunt, end shaped with a jagged formation to condense the weight of a blow to several points, and is balanced on the other end against a curved talon's spike used to puncture thick armor. The Glory Maul is so named for its enchantment, which can grant the wielder with a powerful blessing of might.
		
This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +20
Arcane Resistance: +20%
Damage Boost: +10%
Bestow Might on hit (15%)

label: grimoire
description: A book which divines the mysteries of magic. These volumes can help a reader harness arcane powers.

label: hollow golem
description: A golem crafted from condensed magic and arcane catalysts. The armor surrounding the hollow golem anchors the magic center to a physical location and to protect its physical integrity. The hollow golem is able to harness tremendous amounts of magical energy for a variety of purposes, making it one of the most flexible golems developed to date. The hollow golem absorbs magical energy from the atmosphere, much like paracyte, with mana reduction equivalent to 10 paracyte thorn bushes.

label: Hood of Protection
description:
A simple hood that increases protection, both magical and mundane. The method of infusing fabric with enchantments prior to weaving the hood returns improved enchanting results.

The Hood of Protection is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Arcane Resistance: +10%

label: Wand of Ice
description:
A wand able to slowly convert nearby arcane energy into elemental ice. Wands are used as focusing tools to harness innate power more than as a weapon itself.
	
This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +5
Energy Regen: +5%
Damage Boost: +15%

label: Wand of Lightning
description:
A wand able to slowly convert nearby arcane energy into elemental lightning. Wands are used as focusing tools to harness innate power more than as a weapon itself.

This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +5
Energy Regen: +5%
Damage Boost: +15%

label: Wanderer's Cloak
description:
A cloak designed for traveling mages that provides protection against the elements and improves energy recovery rates. The method of infusing arcane gemstones into the fabric during crafting yields unparalleled enchantment effectiveness.
	
This cloak is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages:
Max Energy: +12%
Ability Cooldown: -20%
Arcane Resistance: +5%

label: Essence of Magic
description: The essence of raw, magical skill. Absorbing the essence grants arcane experience.

label: Essence of Might
description: The essence of raw, martial skill. Absorbing the essence grants martial experience.

label: maharal golem
description: A golem crafted from a mixture of molded stone wrapped in leather.

label: manaweave
description:
Manaweave is cloth that has been fused with magicyte and meticulously imbued with arcane symbols. Manaweave inherits many of the physical properties of cloth, but acquires an additional reactive response to physical force. What makes the fabric unique is its ability to act as a conductor of mana that enhances the effects of enchantments and naturally grants protection against light and dark magic. 

Extremely difficult and taxing to create, only a talented and knowledgeable mage can make this material.

label: Mantle of Protection
description:
A loose, cape-like coat worn over other garments and offering added protection against weather and other hazards. The Mantle of Protection is magically infused with warding runes to further its defense. The method of infusing arcane gemstones into the fabric during crafting yields unparalleled enchantment effectiveness.
	
This cloak is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages:
Class XP Gain: +20%
Arcane Resistance: +30%

label: mecha-golem
description: A golem, crafted from raw material and given basic autonomy through a combination of circuitry and magic.

label: Shroud of the Soulreaper
description:
This dark and mystical ensemble is crafted with a macabre elegance, blending bone motifs and shadowy enchantments to provide both protection and serve as a conduit for the necromancer's unholy powers. The Shroud of the Soulreaper is a testament to the necromancer's mastery over the forces of death, shrouding them in an aura of ominous power as they manipulate the very fabric of life and afterlife. While the shroud may be worn by anyone, its unique properties improve the necromancer's control over the undead.
	
Necromancers derive additional power from the symbolism of this dark garment:
Max Energy: +40
Energy Regen: +30%
Arcane Power: +30%

Shroud of Undeath: reduces undead upkeep costs by 30% for this necromancer and increases movement and attack power by 15% for nearby undead

label: Cowl of the Soulreaper
description:
This ominous garment is woven from shadowy fabrics and imbued with dark enchantments, concealing the visage of the necromancer beneath a mask of cloth and bone. The Cowl of the Soulreaper serves not only as a practical accessory to shield the wearer from prying eyes but also as a symbolic manifestation of the necromancer's communion with the realms beyond life. Its eerie aura and sinister design make it a fitting adornment for those who harness the powers of the undead and tread the paths of necromantic arts.

Necromancers derive additional power from the symbolism of this item:
Max Energy: +20
Energy Regen: +5%

Shroud of Undeath: reduces undead upkeep costs by 20% for this necromancer and increases movement and attack power by 10% for nearby undead

label: Mask of the Soulreaper
description:
Crafted with an eerie elegance, this disconcerting mask combines dark materials and arcane symbols, concealing the necromancer's countenance behind a haunting facade. Its eerie aura and sinister design make it a fitting adornment for those who harness the powers of undeath and tread the paths of necromantic arts.

Necromancers derive additional power from the symbolism of this item:
Max Energy: +10
Energy Regen: +5%

Shroud of Undeath: reduces undead upkeep costs by 10% for this necromancer and increases movement and attack power by 5% for nearby undead

label: mashed pomana
description: A bitter and unappetizing byproduct when extracting syrrium from raw pomonasyrrium. This byproduct retains some nutritional value but is largely left for animal consumption or as a nutrient base for meals.

label: pomana fruit
description: A fist sized fruit with hues ranging from sunset orange to dusky violet, pomona is primarily considered a delicacy due to its commonality and is usually enjoyed raw as a desert.  When consumed raw, it generates a mild euphoric sensation of mental well-being and has been found to open up mental pathways, expanding consciousness.

label: Ruunbled
description:
This a massive blade is etched in intricate runes from hilt to tip. It is forged in a material unknown to you, with a razor sharp edge and weighing only a fraction of what the size infers. Despite its size, the weapon is easy to handle, and practically hums with power. You can only fathom the origins of this weapon - perhaps crafted in ancient technologies that were lost to time or fabricated with some mysterious power. The only hint is small word written in a stylish script and imprinted into the hilt with the name "Ruunbled." You are not sure if this is a manufacturing company, the name of its maker, or the name of the blade itself. Whichever it is, there is no doubt that this weapon represents the pinnacle of its class.
		
This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Ability Cooldown: -20%
Energy Costs: -20%
Damage Boost: +25%
Arcane Resistance: +25%
Haste on hit (20%)
Deflection (30%)
Cleaving Strike

label: Mask of Serenity
description:
This mask is a captivating blend of mystery and wisdom, meticulously crafted to veil the countenance of the wearer. Delicate lines are etched upon the mask's surface, depicting an intricate dance of ancient symbols and rhythmic lines that combine to form a visage of wisdom and power. Masks of this nature are intended to suppress the physical senses of the wearer, granting them increased concentration and focus.

The Mask of Serenity is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Energy Costs: -10%
Energy Regen: +10%
Class XP Gain: +10%
Arcane Power: +10%

label: silk golem
description: An mass of cloth and thread constructed into a slug-like shape, the only distinct feature is its friendly, expressive face.

label: straw golem
description: A golem crafted from a mixture of basic material formed in the shape of a human.

label: syrrium
description:
Syrrium is distilled from pomana through a process boiling the mashed fruit which separates the syrrium from the pomana. Syrrium induces a much more intense effect than raw pomana when consumed. The chemical effects qualify the liquid as a drug and can cause mild chemical dependency, however, the its more addictive lure is when some begin to feel less capable without the drug and consume syrrium to maintain their confidence and mental balance.

The claims that pomanasyrrium grant insight and clarity is disregarded by most as lore or fantasy, however, research into its chemistry has revealed that these effects are indeed real, at least for mages. The benefits of syrrium are considered the primary reason to cultivate pomanasyrrium. When properly refined, the effects of syrrium have been found to expand a mages access to mana, accelerating its ebb and flow, and decreasing the effort required when exerting arcane power. These effects will not stack with benefits gained by consuming the raw fruit.

label: Thrum Bow
description:
A bow shaped from the horn of a Thrumbo. The horn is hallowed out to decrease the weight and softened by soaking it in a magicyte compound that adds a surprising suppleness to the horn. The bow is further enhanced with embedded enchantments and arcane engravings that travel the length of the bow. The bow is said to be almost sentient, able to determine the intended target through a mental link with the wielder. Arrows fired from this bow almost always hit their intended target. This effect does have a tendency to delude the users own capability, however.

This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +20
Energy Regen: +10%
Damage Boost: +20%
Ability Cooldown: -10%
Class XP Gain: -20%

label: thrumbo axe
description:
An axe crafted using thrumbo horns that are fused together with a clasp made from magicyte. This clasp stores arcane potential and transfers it as physical force when the axe is swung, allowing it to deliver mighty blows capable of cleaving through multiple opponents. The shaft is also etched with magical runes to augment the wielder's power.
		
This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +10
Damage Boost: +20%
Arcane Resistance: +30%
Cleaving Strike

label: thrumbo saber
description:
A razor sharp blade forged from the horn of a thrumbo and infused with arcane energy. The thrumbo saber is lighter than metal blades and it's edge can cut through all but the thickest armor. Many masters of the blade favor this weapon as it is designed for speed and lethality. Further enchantments may also quicken the users, doubling their attack rate for a short period.
		
This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Ability Cooldown: -10%
Damage Boost: +10%
Haste on hit (25%)

label: Winter's Reign
description:
A rod of blue steel adorned with a crown of crystal shards. The touch of this staff never warms, as if to remind the bearer of it's icy sovereignty. The power of the staff is two-fold - it greatly augments the innate magical power of a mage and is able to create a hailstorm in any environment. The power of the staff has its price - when held, the staff will drain heat and energy from the holder and, if held by a mage, expands this effect to the surrounding atmosphere. Only mages are able to project the power of this staff.

This weapon is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +80
Ability Cooldown: -30%
Arcane Resistance: +20%
Arcane Damage: +50%

Ability: Hailstorm

label: Wizard Hat
description:
A classic hat styled for any wizard or witch. This hat has secret carrying compartments and also has social and drug production bonuses.

The Wizard Hat is enchanted and provides additional benefits to trained mages and fighters:
Max Energy: +5%
Arcane Power: +5%

label: wood golem
description: Magical energy infused into a construct of wood and stone.

label: bionics workbench
description: A workbench equipped for production of high tech bionics and implants. This advanced workbench is capable of assisting certain workstations by sharing some of its specialized fabrication system when placed near them.\n\nWhen placed near a prosthetic workbench, synthetic nano printer or the fabrication bench, this workbench is able to increase their production speed. They can connect to a maximum of one bionics workbench.

label: butcher table
description: A heavy table for butchering dead creatures into pieces of raw meat. Rotting or dessicated corpses cannot be butchered.

label: machining table
description: A work station for assembling machinery like guns and ammunition, or breaking down dead mechanoids.

label: synthetic nano printer
description: A fabrication workstation, equipped with a 3D printer to craft organs and complicated implants. This advanced workbench is capable of assisting certain workstations by sharing some of its specialized fabrication system when placed near them.\n\nWhen placed near a prosthetic workbench, bionics table or fabrication bench, this workbench is able to increase their production speed. They can connect to a maximum of one synthetic nano printer.

label: art bench
description: A workbench equipped for creating art.

label: stonecutter's table
description: A work table with saws and chisels for cutting stone chunks into usable blocks.

label: tactical cornea implant
description: An enhanced implant which provides the user with additional information about potential targets and suggests a perfect firing angle.

label: techprint (artificial metabolism)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "artificial metabolism" research project. Craft bionics that process food more safely or efficiently than a biological stomach.

label: techprint (brain wiring)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "brain wiring" research project. Craft brain implants that induce or prevent blunt sensations like joy or pain.

label: techprint (cataphract armor)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "cataphract armor" research project. Craft cataphract armor, heavy powered armor that slows the user but which can absorb extreme punishment. Note that these also require advanced components.

label: techprint (circadian influence)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "circadian influence" research project. Craft brain implants that chemically manipulate the circadian rhythm, reducing or altering the need to sleep.

label: techprint (compact weaponry)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "compact weaponry" research project. Craft compact, concealable bionic weapons which can be embedded in various body parts.

label: techprint (flesh shaping)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "flesh shaping" research project. Craft bionics which induce the reshaping of natural flesh, usually for the purposes of aesthetic enhancement or personal pleasure.

label: techprint (healing factors)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "healing factors" research project. Craft bionics that enhance natural healing processes.

label: techprint (jump packs)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "jump packs" research project. Build jump packs to perform aerial assaults during combat.

label: techprint (molecular analysis)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "molecular analysis" research project. Craft bionics with molecular analyzers for assisting the immune system or analyzing food.

label: techprint (neural computation)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "neural computation" research project. Craft brain implants that assist thought and learning by use of a direct, shallow brain-computer interface.

label: techprint (skin hardening)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "skin hardening" research project. Craft bionic implants which induce the toughening of natural skin, producing an armor-like effect.

label: techprint (specialized limbs)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "specialized limbs" research project. Craft specialized bionic limbs built for specific purposes - both combat and labor.

label: techprint (poison synthesis)
description: An exotic consumable item, consumed to unlock progress on the "poison synthesis" research project. Craft bionics that synthesize venom from internal chemical reactors for use in toxifying attacks.

label: techprof subpersona core
description: A small AI core housing a low-grade subpersona specialized in teaching technology. When used, the AI will teach you the technology you're currently researching, instantly and for free. Can only be used once.

label: telescope
description: A telescope for doing amateur astronomy. It's a relaxing hobby for a certain kind of person. Can only be used outdoors.

label: textbook
description: A book which focuses on teaching skills.

label: meditation throne
description: A large, ornate chair designed for a dignity-focused psycaster to sit and meditate. Reigning on a throne is a form of meditation that builds up psyfocus. For dignity psycasters, more impressive meditation thrones and thronerooms increase the rate of psyfocus gain.

label: thrumbo
description: A gigantic, graceful creature of unknown origin. The thrumbo is gentle by nature, but extremely dangerous when enraged. While its long fur is exceptionally beautiful, its hide is also incredibly resistant to damage. Its razor-sharp horn fetches a huge price.\n\nLegends say that an old thrumbo is the wisest creature in the universe - it simply chooses not to speak.

label: thrumbo horn
description: A thrumbo's horn. It's razor-sharp, rock-hard, and priceless in most markets. This is a true trophy, as well as a deadly melee weapon.

label: tiger
description: A solitary and dangerous apex predator. Tigers make quick work of their prey, using a mix of stealth and razor-sharp claws.

label: tome
description: A book which explores dark psychic powers, the void hidden under space, and the dreams of evil superintelligences. These volumes can help a reader harness dark entities and powers.

label: tool cabinet
description: Increases work speed when placed near a workbench. One workbench can use up to two tool cabinets.

This arcane script is incomplete and the reader may not be able to learn some, or any, arcane spells.

label: Torn Script: Bard
description:
Teaches a gifted pawn how to become a professional bard. Bards are incapable of dumb labor and this work type will be disabled.
This arcane script is incomplete and the reader may not be able to learn some, or any, bard abilities.

label: Torn Script: Chaos
description: Teaches a gifted pawn chaos tradition.

label: Torn Script: Chronomancy
description:
Teaches a gifted pawn how to become a chronomancer, able to see and manipulate realities across time.
This arcane script is incomplete and the reader may not be able to learn some, or any, chronomancer abilities.

label: Torn Script: Demonology
description:
Details the process to enter an agreement with a demon to gain power. This contract binds the patron, in a literal sense, with demonic essence that affects their genetic makeup. This binding affects males and females differently. Demons will only agree to the contract if the user is magically gifted. 
	
*Note scribbled at the bottom of the first page* This script is not clear on exactly what the demon gets out of the agreement... use with caution.

This arcane script is incomplete and does not explain the full contract process; the result might not immediately provide full access to all abilities.

This arcane script is incomplete and the reader may not be able to learn some, or any, geomancer abilities.

This arcane script is incomplete and the reader may not be able to learn some, or any, enchanter abilities.

label: Torn Script: Golemancer
description: Teaches a gifted pawn how to become a golemancer; a reclusive mage that channels arcane energy into mundane objects using sigils and runes.

label: Torn Script: Ice

label: Torn Script: Fire

Teaches a gifted pawn how to harness elements of fire.  
This arcane script is incomplete and the reader may not be able to learn some, or any, fire spells.

label: Torn Script: Priest

This arcane script is incomplete and the reader may not be able to learn some, or any, priest spells.

label: Torn Script: Shaman
description: Teaches a gifted pawn how to become a shaman; a tribal leader focused on ritualistic magic to create powerful curses and enchantments, and extends their influence through totems.

label: Torn Script: Lightning

This arcane script is incomplete and the reader may not be able to learn some, or any,  lightning spells.
