label: Torn Script: Necromancy
description:
Teaches a gifted pawn how to manipulate forces of life and death. *Note: The necromancer may become a lich at a later stage, lichs are incapable of all activity except fighting and research. Many other magic classes dislike necromancers. Choose carefully.
This arcane script is incomplete and the reader may not be able to learn some, or any, necromancer spells.

label: Torn Script: Paladin
description:
Teaches a gifted pawn how to harness holy powers.  
This arcane script is incomplete and the reader may not be able to learn some, or any, holy spells.

label: tornado generator
description: An ancient control unit for a network of weather-control satellites. This device has had certain failsafes bypassed; it is capable of causing a massive air current disturbance, which will generate a tornado at a chosen location. The weather network will detect this unauthorized intrusion and lock out the device after use, but the tornado will be left to spend its energy normally.

label: tortoise
description: This heavily armored land-dwelling reptile is known for its slow moving speed and surprisingly vicious bite. Because of its natural armor, it is tough to kill and can do serious damage during drawn-out melee fights.

label: totemic slab (broad)
description: A wooden bas relief of totemic imagery for decorating a floor.

label: totemic slab (medium)
description: A wooden bas relief of totemic imagery for decorating a floor.

label: toughskin gland
description: This bionic gland releases chemicals and nanomachines that toughen the skin, making it somewhat more resistant to damage. While it doesn't add as much protection as some other skin-hardening glands, the toughskin gland has the advantage of not noticeably altering the user's appearance.

label: toxalope
description: A pollution-adapted cousin of the boomalope, the toxalope grows toxic pouches on its back. When it dies, the toxic material explodes and produces a deadly toxic cloud. Unlike the boomalope, the toxalope cannot be milked.

label: toy box
description: A toy box containing many small toys. Toy boxes can be used to play with babies, satisfying their need for play.

label: IED antigrain warhead trap
description: An antimatter-powered antigrain warhead connected to a trigger which detonates on touch or bullet impact. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

label: IED deadlife trap
description: A pair of deadlife shells connected to a trigger which detonates on touch or bullet impact. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.\n\nThe trap needs corpses nearby to be raised by the deadlife dust.

label: IED EMP trap
description: A pair of EMP shells connected to a trigger which detonates on touch or bullet impact. The explosion can paralyze mechanoids for a few seconds. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

label: spike trap
description: Five spikes under tension, connected to a touch-activated trigger. When the victim disturbs the trigger, the spikes spring forth and strike the victim. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

label: tube television

label: turkey
description: A short, fat, flightless bird known for its hilarious 'gobbling' call. It has been long domesticated, but also lives in the wild.

label: foam turret
description: An activatable turret for extinguishing fires. The turret stands idle until someone approaches and activates it, after which it will automatically spray large amounts of firefoam on any flames in sight.

label: mini-turret
description: A portable automatic turret. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.

label: mortar
description: A manned mortar that launches all kinds of shells. While it can inflict devastating damage, the mortar's inherent inaccuracy makes it more useful for attacking large fortifications than groups of enemies in the field.

label: Unfinished Arcane Book
description:
A arcane tome ready to be filled with the secrets of unlocking magical powers...
		
Use a trained mage to record their arcane secrets in the book. The book can then be used to teach another, gifted pawn how to become the same class. Arcane Tomes will promote a gifted pawn to a magic class and all class abilities except the master ability.

Gifted pawns can journal their theories and experiments in this book and learn to become a random magic class.

An arcane script ready to be filled with the secrets of unlocking magical powers...

description:

Use a trained fighter to record their combat techniques in the book. The book can then be used to teach another pawn this combat technique.

Physically adept pawns can journal their research and training in this book to develop the concepts of a random fighter class.

label: unstable power cell
description:

An internal amplifier system makes it unstable. If damaged, the unit will generate a massive explosion.

Some brave humans steal these from mechanoids for their own use as power plants or defensive bombs. However, an unintentional detonation can be devastating.

description: A biological human toe, fleshcrafted from a corpse. This can be safely installed in colonists following a Fleshcrafting ideoligion, but will cause infections due to organ rejection in others.

label: fleshcrafted tongue
description: A biological human tongue, fleshcrafted from a corpse. This can be safely installed in colonists following a Fleshcrafting ideoligion, but will cause infections due to organ rejection in others.

label: mechanoid effigy
description: A structure assembled from scrapped mechanoid parts. Emits an IFF programming signal capable of confusing ancient mechanoid receptors. Should two exist per colonist enough signal noise will soft reset ancient mechanoid programming, causing an immediate retreat. This will only work on raiding mechanoids, clusters and "boss" mechanoids won't be affected.

label: ominous obelisk
description: An ominous-looking obelisk of pure chiseled stone. It seems to radiate an aura of hopelessness and despair.\n\nThe Corruption need of any colonist in an obelisk's radius of effect won't decrease.

label: serketist slab (broad)
description: A stone bas relief of serketist imagery for decorating a floor.

label: serketist slab (medium)
description: A stone bas relief of serketist imagery for decorating a floor.

label: shintao slab (broad)
description: A stone bas relief of shintao imagery for decorating a floor.

label: shintao slab (medium)
description: A stone bas relief of shintao imagery for decorating a floor.

label: wicker man
description: A large humanoid figure made out of dry brush, thatch, and wood scraps. Prisoners have to be physically restrained to the figurine then burned alive as part of a trial or ritual.

label: dart gun
description: A non-lethal air gun used to reduce irritability or agitation in animals or humans via anesthetic drugs commonly referred to as tranquilizers.

label: non-lethal pistol
description: A modern design of a gas-operated pistol firing rubber pellets. While chances of serious injury are lower, there is still a chance blunt trauma will result in death.

label: taser gun
description: An industrial tech short range taser pistol. It delivers an electric shock aimed at temporarily disrupting muscle functions and inflicting pain without usually causing significant injury.

label: tear gas launcher
description: A modern single-shell launcher loaded with tear gas canisters. Often used by riot police across almost all urbworlds.

label: stun baton
description: A short peacekeeping baton with electroshock prod that delivers an electric shock aimed at temporarily disrupting muscle functions.

label: tear gas grenades
description: Modern canister containing a special compound commonly referred to as tear gas. Temporarily blinds victims.

label: vacskin gland
description: This bionic gland releases a waxy substance that forms an insulating barrier on the skin, preventing vacuum burns but restricting movement. The gland also regulates blood oxygen levels, allowing longer survival in the vacuum of space.

label: vanometric power cell
description: Generates free energy, forever, without using fuel. This technology is developed by archotechs, and is beyond even most glitterworld societies. While nobody knows exactly how it works, scholars believe it somehow extracts energy directly from fluctuations in the quantum foam.

label: venom fangs
description: A pair of injectors implanted through the canine teeth, connected to a venom pump. The user can bite an enemy, extend the injectors, and pump venom into the target.

label: venom talon
description: A retractable finger talon connected to a venom pump in the lower arm. The user can scratch an enemy while squirting venom into the wound. The talon is designed to be installed in the middle finger. It's fast, but poor at penetrating armor.

label: vitals monitor
description: Increases medical tend quality, surgery success chance, and immunity gain speed when placed directly adjacent to a hospital bed. Only works for hospital beds - normal beds will not benefit. Attaching more than one vitals monitor to the same bed will have no effect.

label: void sculpture
description: An unsettling sculpture made from bioferrite. The psychic properties of bioferrite enhance the quality of any psychic rituals performed nearby.\n\nUp to six void sculptures can connect to a psychic ritual spot.

label: voidsight serum
description: A capsule of oily black fluid that squirms endlessly inside the glass. When injected into the eye, it suppresses the inhibitory neurons that keep perception focused on the real world, thus lifting dark psychic phenomena into conscious perception. This increases the amount of knowledge gained when studying unnatural entities, as well as psychic sensitivity, but also impacts mood.\n\nThe effect is temporary and does not stack.

label: vulture
description: Scavengers with strong beaks and broad wings. Their strong stomach acid allows them to eat rotting corpses.

label: wake-up
description: A synthetic stimulant. Wake-up fills the user's need for rest, allowing them to work for extended periods without getting tired. However, taking wake-up runs the risk of developing an addiction.\n\nIn the most competitive universities and companies of many worlds, high-achievers are sometimes called 'wake-ups' because of the association with this drug.

label: wake-up rib implant
description: An artificial rib, equipped with little wake-up-dispensers to keep the user awake and focused.

label: wall lamp
description: A wall-mounted lamp that lights an area using electricity. It is less powerful than a standing lamp, but can be mounted on walls.

label: walrus
description: A large marine animal with tusks and whiskers. Its considerable bulk allows it to survive in extremely cold environments. While slow on land, it is relatively quick in water.

label: warg
description: Heavily-muscled wolf-like creatures with vicious unnatural claws and an absurdly powerful bite. They will only eat meat or corpses. If disturbed in the wild, they are very likely to attack.\n\nScientists say wargs are the descendants of weaponized military animals created for population suppression. The superstitious see them as the tools of an angry god.

label: wasp trap
description: Several dormant wasp drones. They activate when they detect threats, injecting their target with a paralytic biotoxin.

label: waste rat
description: A toxin-adapted variant of the common rat. Waste rats have evolved to be pollution-resistant, as well as larger, tougher, and more aggressive than standard rats. Their bite infects their attacker with toxic buildup.

label: EMP grenades
description: Electromagnetic pulse grenades damaging to electronic equipment.

label: frag grenades
description: Old-school fragmentation grenades. They can be thrown a short distance, where they'll explode, damaging anything and anyone nearby.

label: molotov cocktails
description: Glass bottles filled with flammable liquid, with a burning cloth in the neck. A favorite weapon of hooligans and desperate warriors from rim to rim.

label: tox grenades
description: Grenades loaded with liquified tox gas. Upon landing, they stick to the ground and release tox gas for several seconds.\n\nTox gas burns the lungs and eyes, causing a temporary shortness of breath and reduction in sight. Continued exposure to tox gas results in toxic buildup which can be lethal.

label: wild boar
description: This hairy omnivore is descended from escaped pigs and evolved for living in the wild.\n\nIts tusks make it a better fighter than its domesticated pig cousins. Unfortunately, it is too unruly to be trained in the most complex tasks.

label: arctic wolf
description: An arctic variant of the old Earth wolf. As pack hunters, wolves have a complex social life and are fiercely intelligent.

label: greatwolf
description: A genetically engineered canine modeled on long-extinct dire wolves. These fearsome predators were created as pets for the glitterworld elite. Wild greatwolves now populate many planets, due to their tendency to escape confinement.

label: timber wolf
description: A rugged predator long feared by many ancient Earth cultures. As pack hunters, wolves have complex social lives and are fiercely intelligent.

label: wolverine
description: A small but ferocious predator. Wolverines are solitary animals that prefer to eat carrion but can kill animals many times their size if needed.

label: wood
description: Wood from trees or other fibrous plants. Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires and generators, and can be refined into chemfuel. In a pinch, a piece of wood can be used as a weapon or a leg.

label: alpaca wool
description: The remarkably soft wool of an alpaca. It is warm, protects well from heat, and fetches a high price.

label: bison wool
description: Thick and coarse wool of a bison. Quite warm.

label: mastodon wool
description: Thick shaggy wool from a mastodon. Provides excellent insulation against the cold.

label: megasloth wool
description: While somewhat coarse, megasloth wool's long fibers make it very strong. It is exceptionally warm.

label: muffalo wool
description: Soft, light and provides very good insulation. Muffalo wool clothes can keep the body warm even in very cold conditions.

label: muskox wool
description: Itchy wool from a muskox. Good at keeping the cold out.

label: sheep wool
description: Sheep's wool. It provides good insulation.

label: wort
description: Un-fermented beer. This substance needs to ferment in a fermenting barrel before it becomes drinkable beer.

label: xenogerm
description:
A self-contained biological organ containing one or more implantable xenogenes.

Once implanted inside a host's body, the xenogerm modifies the host's genes, gene expression, and phenotypic development using viruses, hormones, bio-synthesized drugs, and possibly mechanites. Depending on the xenogerm, the host will develop any of a wide variety of exotic traits and abilities, transforming them into a different human xenotype.

Xenogerm implantation is a traumatic process. Once implanted with a xenogerm, a person will be bedridden for days as the transformation sets in.

During storage and transport, xenogerms are kept safe in sealed containers.

label: yak
description: Yaks are robust cattle with a bulky frame, short but thick legs, and rounded cloven hooves that are splayed to help them walk in snow.

label: yayo
description: A refined powdery preparation of the psychite drug. When snorted, it produces a rapid euphoric high, dramatically reduces the user's need for rest, and suppresses pain. Like all forms of psychite, it is addictive, though it is not as addictive as the cruder flake.\n\nBecause of its high cost and refined appearance, many cultures associate yayo with degenerate wealth. Whether in the throneroom or the boardroom, many hare-brained policy schemes have been developed during yayo-fueled binge parties.

label: yorkshire terrier
description: A small, even-tempered dog. Originally bred to hunt rats, it later became a show and companionship animal. Some consider it useless, but the mood boost it gives by nuzzling can outweigh the cost of feeding it.

label: tornado
description: A tornado touches down and tears a destructive path across the map, damaging anything in its way.

label: tornados
description: Multiple tornadoes touch down at once, each carving its own path of destruction.

label: clearweather
description: Immediately clears the sky, ending whatever weather is currently active.

label: rain
description: A gentle rain begins falling — useful for extinguishing fires and watering crops.

label: vomitrain
description: A revolting rain of bile falls from the sky, unsettling anyone caught in it.

label: foggyrain
description: A rain that reduces visibility even further than normal fog.

label: rainythunderstorm
description: A thunderstorm rolls in with rain and lightning, carrying a real risk of fires from lightning strikes.

label: drythunderstorm
description: A thunderstorm with lightning but no rain — the fire risk from strikes is especially dangerous since nothing puts the flames out.

label: snowgentle
description: A gentle snowfall begins, gradually blanketing the map.

label: snowhard
description: A heavy snowstorm blankets the map quickly, slowing movement and cutting visibility.

label: fog
description: Thick fog rolls in, reducing shooting accuracy and visibility across the map.

label: heatwave
description: A dangerous spike in temperature across the map, risking heatstroke for anyone without cooling.

label: flashstorm
description: A sudden, intense rainstorm with strong winds.

label: coldsnap
description: A sudden severe drop in temperature, risking hypothermia for anyone without proper heat or warm clothing.

label: solarflare
description: Disables all electricity-powered devices across the map for its duration, regardless of power source.

label: shortcircuit
description: A random powered conduit or device short-circuits, often starting a fire.

label: toxicfallout
description: A long-lasting toxic haze blankets the region, slowly poisoning exposed creatures and killing surface plant life.

label: volcanicwinter
description: Ash and cold blot out the sun across the world for an extended period, killing plant growth and dropping temperatures globally.

label: eclipse
description: A solar eclipse darkens the map for its duration, disabling solar power and requiring artificial light for outdoor work.

label: aurora
description: A beautiful aurora lights up the night sky, giving a mood boost to anyone who sees it.

label: blight
description: A plant disease begins spreading through a crop, threatening to destroy it if left unchecked.

label: animaltame
description: Instantly tames a wild animal on the map for the colony.

label: resourcepodcrash
description: A pod crashes to the ground carrying a stash of resources for the colony to recover.

label: tradercaravan
description: A caravan of traders arrives, offering goods to buy and sell.

label: orbitaltraderarrival
description: An orbital trade ship comes into range, offering goods to buy and sell via comms console.

label: meteor
description: A meteorite crashes into the map, sometimes exposing valuable minerals to mine.

label: maninblack
description: A mysterious stranger appears with rare items to trade.

label: madanimal
description: An animal on the map suddenly goes berserk and attacks whoever's nearby.

label: psychicdrone
description: A psychic wave sweeps the map, souring the mood of anyone psychically sensitive.

label: psychicsoothe
description: A calming psychic wave sweeps the map, boosting the mood of anyone psychically sensitive.

label: ambrosiasprout
description: A patch of wild ambrosia fruit sprouts somewhere on the map — a rare, delicious treat.

label: herdmigration
description: A large herd of animals migrates across the map, a hunting or taming opportunity.

label: farmanimals
description: A group of farm animals wanders onto the map.

label: wildman
description: A feral wild man wanders into view, available to recruit to the colony.

label: rarethrumbos
description: A rare herd of thrumbos — one of RimWorld's most valuable and dangerous animals — appears on the map.

label: shipchunkdrop
description: Chunks of wreckage from a destroyed ship fall onto the map, sometimes carrying valuable salvage.

label: travelergroup
description: A group of travelers passes through, available to interact with or recruit from.

label: visitorgroup
description: A group of friendly visitors arrives at the colony to socialize for a while.

label: skillincrease
description: Instantly boosts one of a chosen pawn's skills.

label: party
description: Throws a colony-wide social gathering, boosting the mood of everyone who attends.

label: alphabeavers
description: A pack of alpha beavers appears — unusually intelligent, industrious, and aggressive beavers that can be a genuine threat.

label: shippartpoison
description: A piece of crashed ship wreckage releases a cloud of toxic gas on impact.

label: shippartpsychic
description: A piece of crashed ship wreckage releases a wave of psychic energy on impact, souring nearby minds.

label: militaryaid
description: Calls in a group of allied soldiers to help defend the colony.

label: raid
description: A hostile group attacks the colony.

label: dropraid
description: A hostile group drops in via pods, often landing close to or inside the colony's defenses.

label: sapperraid
description: A hostile group digs and tunnels its way toward the colony rather than approaching in the open.

label: siegeraid
description: A hostile group sets up camp nearby and bombards the colony with mortar fire.

label: mechanoidraid
description: A group of hostile mechanoids attacks the colony.

label: infestation
description: A hive of insectoid creatures bursts up from underground within the colony — dangerous if it happens close to home.

label: manhunterpack
description: A pack of animals goes manhunter, turning hostile and attacking anyone in sight.

label: predators
description: A group of predator animals turns hostile and hunts colonists.

label: randomdisease
description: Infects a random colonist with a randomly chosen disease.

label: disease
description: Infects a chosen colonist with a chosen disease.

label: reviveanypawn
description: Revives a dead pawn of the buyer's choosing.

label: pawn
description: Purchases a new pawn to join the colony (or to adopt, if the buyer doesn't have one yet).

label: levelskill
description: Instantly raises one of a pawn's skills by a set amount.

label: trait
description: Adds a chosen trait to a pawn.

label: removetrait
description: Removes a chosen trait from a pawn.

label: genderswap
description: Swaps the gender of the targeted pawn.

label: prisoner
description: Adds a new prisoner to the colony's cells.

label: visitcolony
description: Sends the buyer's pawn to travel to and visit the colony, if not already present.

label: randominspire
description: Grants a random pawn a burst of inspiration.

label: torytalkervote
description: Forces a chat vote among all random events, letting viewers pick what happens next (via the Tory Talker companion bot).

label: hodlbotvote
description: Forces a chat vote like Tory Talker, but weighted toward raids and hazards (via the HodlBot companion bot).

label: reviveall
description: Revives every dead pawn belonging to the colony.

label: reviveme
description: Revives the buyer's own dead pawn.

label: healall
description: Fully heals every pawn in the colony.

label: healanypawn
description: Fully heals a pawn of the buyer's choosing.

label: healme
description: Fully heals the buyer's own pawn.

label: surgery
description: Performs a chosen surgery or operation on a pawn.

label: passionshuffle
description: Randomly reshuffles which skills a pawn is passionate about.

label: replacetrait
description: Replaces one of a pawn's traits with a different chosen one.

label: rescueme
description: Rescues the buyer's pawn from a dangerous situation and brings them to safety.

label: fullheal
description: Fully heals a targeted pawn, curing all injuries and diseases.

label: passion
description: Grants a pawn passion (heightened interest) in a chosen skill.

label: removepassion
description: Removes a pawn's passion in a chosen skill.

label: backpack
description: Grants a pawn additional carrying capacity.

label: settraits
description: Sets a pawn's full list of traits directly.

label: cleartraits
description: Removes all of a pawn's traits.

label: use
description: Forces a pawn to use or consume a chosen item.

label: wear
description: Forces a pawn to wear a chosen piece of apparel.

label: equip
description: Forces a pawn to equip a chosen weapon.

label: randomchildhood
description: Rerolls a pawn's childhood backstory at random.

label: randomadulthood
description: Rerolls a pawn's adulthood backstory at random.

label: sanctuary
description: Grants the colony a period of complete safety, preventing hostile events from triggering.

label: nudist
description: Friedrich enjoys the feeling of freedom that comes from being nude. he can handle clothing, but will be happier without it.

label: bloodlust
description: Friedrich gets a rush from hurting people, and never minds the sight of blood or death. he is four times as likely to start a social fight as others.

label: kind
description: Friedrich is an exceptionally agreeable and giving person. he rarely insults others and will sometimes offer kind words to brighten the moods of those around him. he also never judges people by their appearance. his agreeableness also makes him more likely to conform to prevailing opinions.

label: psychopath
description: Friedrich has no empathy. The suffering of others doesn't bother him at all. he doesn't mind if others are butchered, left unburied, imprisoned, or sold to slavery - unless it affects him. he also feels no mood boost from socializing.

label: cannibal
description: Friedrich was taught that eating human meat is wrong and horrible. But one time, long ago, he tried it... and he liked it.

label: abrasive
description: Friedrich always says exactly what's on his mind, especially if it's bugging him. That tends to rub people the wrong way.

label: toosmart
description: Friedrich is too smart for his own good. he learns everything much faster than everyone, but can be quite eccentric.

label: brawler
description: Friedrich likes to fight up close and personal. his accuracy is greatly increased in melee combat, but he'll be very unhappy if asked to carry a ranged weapon.

label: masochist
description: For Friedrich, there's something exciting about getting hurt. he doesn't know why, he's just wired differently.

label: nightowl
description:
Friedrich likes to be up during the night, and sleep during the day.

he gets a mood bonus if awake at night (23h-6h) and mood loss if awake during the day (11h-18h).

he doesn't get a mood penalty for being in the dark.

label: greedy
description: Friedrich needs a really impressive bedroom. he gets a mood loss if he doesn't get what he wants.

label: jealous
description: For Friedrich, it's degrading to have a less impressive bedroom than someone else. he gets a mood loss if any colonist has a more impressive bedroom.

label: ascetic
description: Friedrich has forsaken physical comforts and enjoyments in favor of a simple, pure lifestyle. he will become unhappy if he has a bedroom that's too impressive. he also dislikes fancy food and prefers to eat raw. he never judges others by their appearance.

label: gay
description: Friedrich is romantically attracted to people of his own gender.

label: bisexual
description: Friedrich is romantically attracted to both men and women.

label: asexual
description: Friedrich has no sexual attraction to anyone at all.

label: annoyingvoice
description: Friedrich's voice has a particularly grating, nasal quality to it, and he tends to talk in barked, garbled phrases. This predisposes others to dislike him.

label: creepybreathing
description: Friedrich breathes heavily all the time, and sweats constantly. People find it creepy.

label: pyromaniac
description: Friedrich loves fire. he will never extinguish fires, and will occasionally go on random fire starting sprees. he will be happy around flames, and happier when wielding an incendiary weapon.

label: wimp
description: Friedrich is weak and cowardly. Even a little pain will immobilize him.

label: nimble
description: Friedrich has remarkable kinesthetic intelligence. he seems to dance around danger with preternatural grace.

label: fastlearner
description: Friedrich has a knack for learning. he picks things up much faster than others.

label: slowlearner
description: Friedrich is slow on the uptake. he learns much slower than others.

label: undergrounder
description: Friedrich has no need to experience the outdoors or light. he will never feel cooped up or get cabin fever and is not bothered by darkness. However, Friedrich will be unhappy while outdoors.

label: bodymodder
description: Friedrich feels limited in his feeble human body. he often dreams of being enhanced with artificial body parts or xenogenetics.

label: bodypurist
description: Friedrich believes the human body is limited for a reason. To him, artificial body parts and xenogenes are unethical and disgusting.

label: misandrist
description: Friedrich really dislikes and distrusts men.

label: misogynist
description: Friedrich really dislikes and distrusts women.

label: greatmemory
description: Friedrich has a fantastic memory for detail. he will learn new skills slightly faster than other people.

label: tough
description: Friedrich has thick skin, dense flesh, and durable bones. he takes much less damage than other people from the same blows. he is extremely hard to kill.

label: torturedartist
description: Friedrich feels alienated and misunderstood by other human beings. he will have a constant mood debuff, but gain a chance (50%) to get a creativity inspiration after a mental break.

label: gourmand
description: Friedrich's life revolves around food. he gets hungry quickly, and will occasionally be overcome with the urge to eat ravenously, even when not hungry.

label: quicksleeper
description: Friedrich doesn't need as much sleep as the average person. Whether he's sleeping on a bed or on the ground, he will be fully rested in about two thirds the usual time.

label: slowpoke
description: Friedrich is always falling behind the group whenever he goes anywhere.

label: fastwalker
description: Friedrich likes to be where he's going. he walks quicker than most people.

label: jogger
description: Friedrich always moves with a sense of urgency - so much so that others often fail to keep up.

label: chemicalfascination
description: Friedrich is utterly fascinated with chemical sources of enjoyment. Consuming recreational drugs will create a good mood, while abstaining will lead to increasing frustration over time and possibly drug binges. he will ignore directives to not use recreational drugs, and will consume more than a normal person.

label: chemicalinterest
description: Friedrich has an unusual interest in chemical sources of enjoyment. Consuming recreational drugs will create a good mood, while abstaining will lead to increasing frustration over time and possible drug binges. he will ignore directives to not use recreational drugs, and will consume more than a normal person.

label: teetotaler
description: Friedrich abhors the idea of gaining pleasure from chemicals. he strictly avoids alcohol and recreational drugs.
effects: Binging on drug mental state disabled.
Binging on drug mental state disabled.

label: sanguine
description: Friedrich is just naturally upbeat about his situation, pretty much all the time, no matter what it is.

label: optimist
description: Friedrich is naturally optimistic about life. It's hard to get him down.

label: pessimist
description: Friedrich tends to look on the bad side of life.

label: depressive
description: Friedrich is perenially unhappy. he has trouble sustaining a good mood even when everything is fine.

label: iron-willed
description: Friedrich's will is an iron shield. he keeps going through thick and thin, when others broke down long before.

label: steadfast
description: Friedrich is mentally tough and won't break down under stresses that would crack most people.

label: nervous
description: Friedrich tends to crack under pressure.

label: volatile
description: Friedrich is on a hair-trigger all the time. he is the first to break in any tough situation.

label: neurotic
description: Friedrich likes to have things squared away. he will work harder than most to attain this state of affairs, but his nerves can get the better of him.

label: veryneurotic
description: Friedrich feels constantly nervous about everything that has to get done. he will work extremely hard to attain this state of affairs, but his nerves can easily get the better of him.

label: industrious
description: Friedrich has an easy time staying on-task and focused, and gets things done much faster than the average person.

label: hardworker
description: Friedrich is a natural hard worker and will finish tasks faster than most.

label: lazy
description: Friedrich is a little bit lazy.

label: slothful
description: Friedrich loves idleness and hates anything productive. he moves slowly and rarely stays focused on a task.

label: psychicallyhypersensitive
description: Friedrich's mind is like a psychic tuning fork. he is extremely sensitive to psychic phenomena.

label: psychicallysensitive
description: Friedrich's mind is unusually sensitive to psychic phenomena.

label: psychicallydull
description: Friedrich's mind is psychically out of tune with others. he isn't as affected by psychic phenomena.

label: psychicallydeaf
description: Friedrich's mind works on a psychic frequency different from everyone else. he just isn't affected by psychic phenomena.

label: carefulshooter
description: Friedrich takes more time to aim when shooting. he shoots less often than others, but with more accuracy.

label: trigger-happy
description: Pew! Pew! Pew! Friedrich just likes pulling the trigger. he shoots faster than others, but less accurately.

label: beautiful
description: Friedrich is exceptionally beautiful, with an exotic-yet-familiar facial structure and an arresting gaze. People are attracted to him before he even opens his mouth.

label: pretty
description: Friedrich has a pretty face, which predisposes people to like him.

label: ugly
description: Friedrich is somewhat ugly. This subtly repels others during social interactions.

label: staggeringlyugly
description: Friedrich is staggeringly ugly. his face looks like a cross between a drawing by an untalented child, a malformed fetus in a jar of formaldehyde, and a piece of modern art. Others must exert conscious effort to look at him while conversing.

label: super-immune
description: Friedrich has a naturally powerful immune system. he will gain immunity much faster than a normal person would, and can survive illnesses that would kill others.

label: sickly
description: Friedrich has an awful immune system. he gets sick more often than usual, frequently with illnesses that nobody in the colony has been afflicted by.

label: delicate
description: Friedrich has fragile skin and bones. he takes more damage than other people from the same blows.

label: recluse
description: The fewer people in Friedrich's faction, the happier he is. Being alone is best of all.

label: perfectmemory
description: Friedrich has outstanding memory, both in terms of retaining information but also muscle memory. his skills will never decay.

label: occultist
description: Friedrich has deep knowledge of the twisted patterns of dark psychic energy. he can study unnatural entities faster than others. he will also periodically teach this inhuman knowledge to others when he gets the chance.

label: joyous
description: Friedrich has the ability to make everyone feel better and inspire them to be the best version of themselves.

label: bodymastery
description: Friedrich doesn't have basic needs like eating, sleeping, or comfort. his body is driven by some unknown mechanism, which has turned his eyes completely white.

label: disturbing
description: Friedrich is a peculiar person who seems fixated on horrendous ideas. Talking to him is often upsetting.

label: voidfascination
description: Friedrich is strangely intrigued by unnatural entities and is easily enthralled by them.

label: arcaneconduit
description: Friedrich is abnormally receptive to the ebb and flow of mana, he will gain mana 40% faster than normal but his maximum mana capacity is reduced by 20.

label: manawell
description: Friedrich has an increased resistance to the ebb and flow of mana which allows him to hold an additional 40 mana, but reduces his mana regeneration by 20%.

label: boundless
description: Friedrich excels at combat arts and is able to execute combat maneuvers 40% more frequently, however, his talent has fostered an arrogant attitude that reduces his experience gain by 25% and causes other fighters to dislike him.

label: faeblood
description: Friedrich is a descendant of fae folk and has a natural connection to the arcane. his arcane resistance is reduced by 40% but mana regeneration and maximum mana is increased by 20%. Spell costs are reduced by 10%.

label: giantsblood
description: Friedrich is a descendant of giants - endowed with with great strength and stamina, though slow to recover. his max stamina is increased by 80%, but stamina regeneration is reduced by 40%. Any attack made while using a melee weapon, or unarmed, deals an additional 25% damage.

label: enlightened
description: Friedrich is blessed by magic, able to harness its power without suffering the full side-effects. Psychic sensitivity is increased by 50% and any magic ability used only incurs half the normal arcane weakness.

label: cursed
description: Friedrich is cursed by magic - tormented by the constant, burning rush of power through his being, and can only gain relief by expending arcane energy. Friedrich will slowly accumulate arcane weakness up until he would become catatonic, and may become catatonic at any point while at this threshold. Using magical abilities that would normally incur arcane weakness will instead proportionally reduce arcane weakness, as well as the effects of the curse.

label: unaffectedbydeath
description: Friedrich has accepted that death is another part of life and doesn't get upset when learning about a dead ally or seeing one of the undead.

label: undead
description: Friedrich has been reanimated as an undead.

label: magicallygifted
description: Friedrich has a magical gift. he can harness this gift to become a mage by studying the mysterious secrets within an arcane script.

label: empath
description: Friedrich is an empath, able to feel and manipulate the emotions of those around him. his's abilities are tied to magic, but have affected him on a more innate level. However, with training, Friedrich can still become an adept magic user. For better or worse, empath's have a very strong presence and can easily read the presence of others; the effectiveness of their abilities are closely tied to their aptitude for overcoming another's defenses.

label: wanderer
description:
Friedrich is a wanderer; an outcast, half-breed mage class frequently dubbed a hedge-mage. his carefree personality has kept his from developing class abilities. Instead, he has learned to improve on a vast number of utility abilities that allow him to adapt to any situation.
		
Wanderers prefer the open road and gain a mood boost for being in a caravan. Caravans with a wanderer will ignore the movement penalties of any world tile. However, their wanderlust will cause them to suffer a mood penalty for remaining at a colony for too long.

label: firemage
description: Friedrich is attuned with the elements of fire.

label: icemage
description: Friedrich is attuned with the elements of water.

label: lightningmage
description: Friedrich is attuned with the elements of lightning.

label: arcanemage
description: Friedrich is attuned with arcane forces, interacting directly with raw arcane power to move matter and energy at will.

label: druid
description: Friedrich is attuned with the forces of nature.

label: paladin
description: Friedrich has been bestowed with divine might and has sworn to uphold justice wherever he stands.

label: summoner
description: Friedrich is able to summon beings and materialize objects from other planes of existence.

label: necromancer
description: Friedrich is attuned with the forces of death.

label: lich
description: Friedrich has transformed into a lich, forsaking life in exchange for an power and an immortal existence. he disdains menial taks, choosing to employ undead for trivial matters.

label: priest
description: Friedrich is attuned with the forces of life and healing and has taken a vow against harming others.

label: entertainer
description: Friedrich is a natural entertainer, able to lighten the mood and lift the spirits of everyone around him.

label: performer
description: Friedrich is a performer; expanding on natural talent, he has begun to take an conscious role to improve the mood of other colonists.

label: minstrel
description: Everyone loves being around Friedrich. he has talent, wit and skill in many forms of entertainment and is able to make a personal connection with almost everyone.

label: bard
description: Friedrich is a master entertainer. Sharp wit, deft hands, and dry humor are his weapons, and he is a master of all his weapons.

label: succubus
description: Friedrich has a strange genetic strain that grants her enhanced physical attributes. She is also extremely attractive with an exotic facial structure that captures the eye. A succubus is more likely to exploit her physical advantages and have others do her work for her. his succubus charm has its disadvantages and can cause some to become jealous and even despise him.

label: warlock
description: Friedrich is a Warlock - able to manifest physical and demonic forces using his unique access to arcane power. The warlock shares the same genetic mixture as a succubus, but as a male, he is affected with mental enhancements that include clairvoyance and telekineses. The warlock can occasionally affect the outcome of a social interaction using their mental capabilities, regardless of how the interaction actually occurred.

label: geomancer
description: Friedrich is attuned with the earth and natural order, drawing power from the physical realm and intertwining it with arcane energy. he is capable of reinforcing physical elements, and bending them, as he needs.

label: technomancer
description: Friedrich has learned to see magic and science as two parts of the same force and is able to use arcane power to interface directly with components of technology. he is capable of manipulating objects with advanced mechanics, electronics, or computing it to achieve his goals, but has difficulty interacting with biological systems.

label: bloodmage
description:
Friedrich is a blood mage and has consigned to the dark art of manipulating the life blood of living things as a means of increasing his power.

As a blood mage, Friedrich has learned to control the life force within and command it to his will. his connection to life makes it easier to associate with other living things, but doesn't appreciate effort without immediate results.

label: enchanter
description: Friedrich is an enchanter, attuned to the composition of matter and materials. he can manipulate matter to his will, frequently in unnatural ways, and his powers of transmutation can be permanent when sufficient effort is applied.

label: chronomancer
description: Friedrich is a chronomancer. Through arcane sight, he is able to view reality as it once was and as it could be, and can manipulate objects between those realities.

label: chaosmage
description: Friedrich has rejected all predefined magic paths and refuses to attribute objective reality in his search for power; there are no truths, all magic is permitted. This tradition has enabled Friedrich to learn any type of magic, although he will never master any.

label: shadow
description: Friedrich is a half-breed demon with an affinity for shadow magic. he has developed his unique talents through combat training and physical conditioning making him the perfect assassin.

label: brightmage
description: Friedrich is a brightmage, able to harness the powers of light to purge evil. he approaches any task with an unrivaled fervor that usually places him at the forefront. Being a Brightmage introduces a dependency on the sun and light, because of this, Friedrich has developed an intense hatred for shadowy and dark caricatures.

label: shaman
description: Shamans take a more harmonious approach to arcane powers than most mages, choosing to pursue a path that works with the ebb and flow of magic to offset or enhance the natural order. Friedrich is kin to the spirit realm and more attuned to nature and its elements.

label: golemancer
description: Golemancers prefer to weave their magic through powerful runes and sigils that are able to transfer purpose into an object. Friedrich is no exception; he can create runes that enhance basic mechanics, alter chemicals in biological matter, and animate mundane material into life-like, monstrous creatures. Golemancers are most effective when channeling their magic through symbols and find it more difficult to convert mana to energy directly but are also have higher arcane resistances. Most golemancers tend to find rocks more interesting than people and have little concern for cleanliness.

label: possessed
description: The body of Friedrich is inhabited by the spirit of another pawn. Possession in a living pawn creates an internal conflict as the functions of the body are shared between two souls. This conflict can be reduced if personalities align, but will become further aggravated if they contrast. Possession of a deceased pawn will not experience mental conflicts, but will slowly deplete the energy of the possessing spirit. Spirit can be recharged through meditation or absorption.

label: spirit
description: The body of Friedrich is inhabited by the spirit of another pawn. Possession in a living pawn creates an internal conflict as the functions of the body are shared between two souls. This conflict can be reduced if personalities align, but will become further aggravated if they contrast. Possession of a deceased pawn will not experience mental conflicts, but will slowly deplete the energy of the possessing spirit. Spirit can be recharged through meditation or absorption.

label: physicallyadept
description: Friedrich is physically adept and has potential to learn special combat forms.

label: wayfarer
description:
Friedrich is a wayfarer; an self-disciplined fighter that excels at tricks and dirty fighting. his carefree personality has kept him from developing class abilities. Instead, he has learned to improve a vast number of utility abilities that allow him to adapt to any situation.

Wayfarers prefer the open road and will gain a mood boost for being in a caravan, and any caravan with a wayfarer will travel 25% faster. However, wayfarers will suffer a mood penalty if they remain at colony for too long.

label: apothecary
description: Friedrich is an apothecary, trained in the preparation of medicines, balms, tinctures and drugs. his profession exhibits strict discipline and dedication, and he has learned to apply his discipline to more generic, physical skills. With training, he can become capable in many combat techniques to augment his skill in herbs.

label: gladiator
description: Friedrich has learned how to train the Gladiator combat style.

label: woodsman
description: Friedrich is a trained woodsman; preferring the silence and lethality of a bow and armed with field-craft and cunning, he is prepared to defend his land from invaders.

label: hunter
description: Friedrich is a hunter; he employs field-craft, cunning, and skill with a bow to defend his land from invaders.

label: scout
description: Friedrich is a scout; comfortable in the wilds, and relied upon to be the eyes and ears of a colony. he employs expertise in field-craft, cunning, and the bow to defend his land from invaders.

label: ranger
description: Friedrich is a ranger; master of the wilds.  he is a master of his craft and defender of his land.

label: sharpshooter
description: Friedrich has trained to become a sniper, skilled in the economy and accuracy of long range, small arms combat. Training to become a sniper has caused some colonists to be uncomfortable around him, not that he cares.

label: sniper
description: Friedrich has trained to become a sniper, skilled in the economy and accuracy of long range, small arms combat. Becoming a sniper has caused him to become distanced from other colonists and somewhat unapproachable, not that he cares.

label: mastersniper
description: Friedrich is a master sniper, skilled in the economy and accuracy of long range, small arms combat. Being a sniper has made him avoid other colonists, not that they care.

label: legendarysniper
description: Friedrich is a legendary sniper, skilled in the economy and accuracy of long range, small arms combat.  Other colonists avoid eye contact and whisper in corners about how dangerous he is and that suits him just fine.

label: bladesman
description: Friedrich is training to become a master of the blade and excels at fighting in melee combat.

label: blademaster
description: Friedrich has trained to become a sword master, dangerously skilled in melee combat.

label: bladedancer
description: Friedrich is a blade dancer, highly skilled in melee combat.  Watching him fight is like watching a dance, every action precise and flawless as it flows from one form into another.

label: legendarybladedancer
description: Friedrich has become a legend, his skill in melee combat is is known across the world. his skill in combat makes it look as if each movement, each strike, is merely a stitch in a tapestry that depicts his victory.

label: faceless
description: Friedrich is a master of disguise and imitation; able to manipulate and capture the muscle and mental actions of another and release it as their own.

label: psionic
description:
Friedrich is a Psionic - able to manifest mental willpower into raw energy without the use of a psychic amplifier. he is able to project psionic energy but finds it easier and more efficient to apply it as an extension of his body. For this reason, he prefers to be free of encumbering weapons when manifesting psionic energy.

Friedrich has become less social since developing psionic powers, preferring to be unhindered by other pawns.

*The regeneration rate of psionic energy is based on psychic sensitivity - reducing sensitivity to 0 will prevent psionic energy from regenerating.

label: deathknight
description: Friedrich is a Death Knight - harbinger of doom and a representative of the ever approaching inevitability of death and decay. his solemn attitude makes most pawns uneasy and even fewer approve of his methods.

label: monk
description: Friedrich is a Monk, dedicated to mastering Chi - the energy that connects all life in the universe. he harnesses Chi to create magical effects and exceed his physical capabilities. Friedrich is also able to disrupt the Chi in others, affecting their command over spells and abilities.

label: commander
description: As a Commander, Friedrich exhibits a charismatic personality and stalwart presence that makes other pawns want to follow his lead. Commander's utilize the weight of their presence to inspire nearby pawns, and when that's not enough, they can issue orders that drive their followers to victory. Because Friedrich is used to everyone doing his bidding, he considers menial tasks beneath his status, and is generally a lackluster worker.

label: supersoldier
description: Friedrich is a highly trained Soldier, specializing in pistol, shotgun, or rifle weapons. his weapon specialization is augmented by a standard set of combat training. Super Soldiers are trained to be aggressive and consider violence the natural solution to any argument.

label: xenophobe
description: Friedrich hates and distrusts xenos. They see them as little more than animals.

label: xenophile
description: Friedrich thinks aliens are exotic and interesting. They would love to get to know them more and wouldn't mind forming relationships with them.

label: robot
description: NAME is an robot. As a robot HE is a bit faster and not really sensible for psychic phenomena.

label: elder
description: Either the body or mind of Friedrich is one of insight and experience. While some find them old fashioned, others will respect their guidance.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures

label: absent-minded
description: Friedrich tends to let his mind drift, even in the middle of work. he may sometimes stop tasks at random.

label: eccentric
description: Friedrich has a screw loose, but it comes with a sharper scientific mind.

label: perfectionist
description: Friedrich strives for perfection in his work. he produces higher-quality products, but works more slowly. Failing to meet his standards causes unhappiness, and on rare occasions he may abandon a project mid-way.

label: coward
description: Friedrich's instincts lean heavily toward cowardice. In danger, he will often hide or run before standing to fight.

label: brave
description: Friedrich has stronger mental and physical fortitude than most. he can endure pain more readily, and is slower to break under harsh conditions.

label: clumsy
description: Minor bruises and scrapes plague Friedrich, usually from tripping or falling due to poor coordination.

label: heatinclined
description: Friedrich enjoys the heat of a dry summer day. he doesn't mind working up a sweat or sleeping in warmth.

label: coldinclined
description: Friedrich enjoys the chill of a brisk winter night. he doesn't mind shivering or sleeping in the cold.

label: heavysleeper
description: A bomb could go off beside Friedrich while he sleeps, and he would keep right on sleeping. he can't be bothered to work or defend the colony mid-nap.

label: neat
description: Friedrich is naturally hygienic and organized. he doesn't track dirt or scatter trash, and enjoys cleaning.

label: slob
description: Friedrich is naturally sloppy, leaving trash and dirt scattered around. At least he isn't much bothered by messy surroundings.

label: workaholic
description: Friedrich struggles to take breaks or rest mid-job. he will keep working, even at the expense of his health or sleep.

label: ironstomach
description: Friedrich has never known nausea. Food poisoning and vomiting are foreign to him.

label: animallover
description: Friedrich can't stand cruelty toward animals. he feels happier when nuzzled or acting as master to a tamed animal, but is more deeply upset when losing one. he also refuses to butcher animals.

label: animalhater
description: Friedrich believes in human superiority over animals. he dislikes bonding or being nuzzled, but feels satisfaction when animals die or are sold.

label: big-boned
description: Whether from bulk or awkward posture, Friedrich has broken a few chairs in his time, and is likely to break more.

label: rebel
description: Friedrich only plays by his own rules. When forced, he will drag his feet and work more slowly.

label: submissive
description: Friedrich needs clear direction on when and how to act. he works at normal speed only when ordered, and otherwise slows down.

label: vengeful
description: Friedrich is fueled by spite. he can’t stand sharing the colony with rivals, and feels happier when one of them dies.

label: technophobe
description: Whether from trauma or fear of change, Friedrich rejects modernity. he may lash out at machines, refuses to research, and feels satisfaction from destroying mechanoids.

label: fun-loving
description: Friedrich lives for a good time. he remembers parties fondly, and the joy lasts far longer than it does for most.

label: dunce
description: Friedrich has limited mental capacity. he learns slowly and struggles with conversation, but tends to be naturally happy.

label: martialartist
description: Friedrich has trained in melee combat and learned a special move to disarm opponents.

label: snob
description: Friedrich believes they belong in high society, and loves nothing more than critiquing art and brushing elbows with royalty.

label: squeamish
description: Friedrich gets a sour stomach around blood or corpses. Vomiting is just part of life for him.

label: anxious
description: Friedrich is naturally anxious, especially in social situations. he avoids gatherings and sometimes retreats to his room to cope.

label: insatiable
description: No amount of lovin’ is ever enough for Friedrich. he tends to move between partners and seeks intimacy often.

label: prude
description: Friedrich gives his body only to a spouse and would never initiate divorce. he also dislikes nudity more than most.

label: couchpotato
description: An armchair and a screen are all Friedrich needs to be happy. he never tires of watching television, and always feels good after.

label: catperson
description: Friedrich enjoys the company of cats and gravitates toward bonding with them, but dislikes dogs.

label: dogperson
description: Friedrich enjoys the company of dogs and gravitates toward bonding with them, but dislikes cats.

label: prodigy
description: Friedrich has a sharp, logical mind. he researches faster than most, and his rational outlook makes him less prone to mental breaks.

label: menagerist
description: Friedrich believes animals are essential to life and society. he feels happier with more of them around, and is especially skilled at taming and training.

label: oceanlover
description: The sea calls to Friedrich. he feels happier when near the ocean or a deep river.

label: mountainlover
description: The mountains call to Friedrich. he feels happier when near a large mountain.

label: madsurgeon
description: Friedrich hides a twisted obsession. he treats organ harvesting as a dark experiment and takes pleasure in it. Harvesting makes him happy, but going too long without fuels growing unrest.

label: drunkenmaster
description: Friedrich fights best when drunk. he grows more dangerous in melee the more intoxicated he becomes.

label: kleptomaniac
description: Friedrich is compelled to steal, even from guests and allies, risking angering others.

label: stoner
description: Smokeleaf is a way of life for Friedrich. he adores it and would rather die than give it up.

label: lush
description: Alcohol is a way of life for Friedrich. he adores drinking and would rather die than give it up.

label: wanderlust
description: Friedrich loves to travel and feels happiest on the move. he grows restless when staying too long in one place, but moves quickly and forages well while caravanning.

label: insomniac
description: Friedrich is never fully asleep or awake. he lurches along in a slow, shambler-like state, and only sleeps once every few days.

label: worldweary
description: Friedrich has grown tired of the world. he struggles with bleak thoughts, making his personality difficult to befriend.

label: desensitized
description: Friedrich is hardened by old emotional trauma. he feels nothing from death or loss, whether animal, colonist, family, or prisoner.

label: refinedpalate
description: Only the finest meals satisfy Friedrich. he feels indifferent toward ordinary food, but savors lavish meals and gains greater joy from them.

label: academian
description: Through scholastic pursuit, Friedrich has become well-read. he excels in science and medicine, and tends patients with greater skill.

label: groundbreaker
description: Friedrich believes infrastructure is everything. he is a natural builder and stoneworker, constructing and mining with greater speed and efficiency.

label: gastronomist
description: To Friedrich, food is art. he creates beautiful, delicious meals that are almost always safe to eat.

label: ecologist
description: Flora and fauna are vital to Friedrich. he uses every part of plants and animals, and appreciates nature’s gifts.

label: tycoon
description: Friedrich has an eye for silver and a silver tongue to match. he values his own goods highly, and convinces others to do the same.

label: thickskinned
description: Friedrich is strangely hypercoagulating and will bleed much more slowly than most.

label: thinskinned
description: Friedrich is strangely hemophilic and tends to bleed much more profusely than others.

label: schizoid
description: Friedrich bottles up his feelings for long stretches of time. When the pressure grows too great, he may suddenly break down.

label: human
description: A baseline human, mostly unmodified by gene engineering and mostly unchanged by evolutionary pressures on non-Earth planets.

label: human
description: A baseline human, mostly unmodified by gene engineering and mostly unchanged by evolutionary pressures on non-Earth planets.
